"use client";

import type { InitialQualificationProjection } from "@/domains/pilotage/initial-qualification-types";

/**
 * Figma SAS06 (1022:164) — Création et qualification initiale.
 * Dimensions : 702×726 · assets SVG natifs sous /public/figma/sas06/ (download_assets MCP).
 */
const ASSET = {
  halo: "/figma/sas06/icone-halo.svg",
  analyse: "/figma/sas06/icone-analyse.svg",
  confirmCircle: "/figma/sas06/confirmation-cercle.svg",
  confirmIcon: "/figma/sas06/icone-confirme.svg",
  focusHalo: "/figma/sas06/focus-halo.svg",
  evaluation: "/figma/sas06/icone-evaluation.svg",
  wait: "/figma/sas06/repere-attente.svg",
  info: "/figma/sas06/icone-information.svg",
} as const;

export function SasCreateProgressPopup(props: {
  visible: boolean;
  projectName: string;
  step: 1 | 2 | 3;
  /** RB-07/08 — when true, all three steps are TERMINÉ and title is confirmation. */
  complete?: boolean;
  qualification: InitialQualificationProjection | null;
  onDismiss: () => void;
}) {
  if (!props.visible) return null;

  const complete = props.complete === true;
  const displayStep = complete ? 3 : props.step;
  const iqStatus = props.qualification?.status ?? null;
  /** AT-03 — terminal ≠ always « trajectoire prête ». */
  const outcome: "PROPOSED" | "CLARIFICATION" | "FAILED" | "RUNNING" =
    !complete
      ? "RUNNING"
      : iqStatus === "PROPOSED"
        ? "PROPOSED"
        : iqStatus === "FAILED"
          ? "FAILED"
          : iqStatus === "CLARIFICATION"
            ? "CLARIFICATION"
            : "PROPOSED";

  const kicker =
    outcome === "RUNNING"
      ? "PROJET CRÉÉ / TRAJECTOIRE EN PRÉPARATION"
      : outcome === "PROPOSED"
        ? "PROJET CRÉÉ / TRAJECTOIRE PROPOSÉE"
        : outcome === "CLARIFICATION"
          ? "PROJET CRÉÉ / CLARIFICATION NÉCESSAIRE"
          : "PROJET CRÉÉ / REPRISE NÉCESSAIRE";

  const titleText =
    outcome === "RUNNING"
      ? "Projet créé. Nora prépare la suite."
      : outcome === "PROPOSED"
        ? "Préparation terminée. Accède au projet quand tu veux."
        : outcome === "CLARIFICATION"
          ? "Projet créé. Nora a besoin d’une précision avant de proposer la trajectoire."
          : "Projet créé. La qualification initiale n’a pas abouti.";

  const leadText =
    outcome === "RUNNING"
      ? props.projectName
        ? `Nora analyse l’intention de « ${props.projectName} » pour proposer une première trajectoire.`
        : "Nora analyse ton intention pour proposer une première trajectoire."
      : outcome === "PROPOSED"
        ? props.projectName
          ? `La première proposition de trajectoire pour « ${props.projectName} » est disponible dans le fil. Aucun cycle ne démarre sans ton accord.`
          : "La première proposition de trajectoire est disponible dans le fil. Aucun cycle ne démarre sans ton accord."
        : outcome === "CLARIFICATION"
          ? "Une clarification est dans le fil du projet. Réponds-y pour que Nora propose une trajectoire. Aucun cycle n’est ouvert."
          : "Tu peux accéder au projet et reprendre la conversation. Aucun cycle n’a été ouvert.";

  const steps = [
    {
      n: 1 as const,
      title: "Projet créé",
      detail: "Il reste accessible, même si tu quittes Studio.",
      statusDone: "01  TERMINÉ",
      statusCurrent: "01  EN COURS",
      statusPending: "01  À VENIR",
    },
    {
      n: 2 as const,
      title: "Identification des cycles pertinents",
      detail: "Analyse des cycles pertinents et des références CKI.",
      statusDone: "02  TERMINÉ",
      statusCurrent: "02  EN COURS",
      statusPending: "02  À VENIR",
    },
    {
      n: 3 as const,
      title: "Première réponse de Nora",
      detail:
        outcome === "CLARIFICATION"
          ? "Clarification dans le fil — pas encore de proposition de trajectoire."
          : outcome === "FAILED"
            ? "La qualification n’a pas abouti ; tu peux reprendre dans le projet."
            : "Une proposition de trajectoire dans le fil du projet.",
      statusDone: "03  TERMINÉ",
      statusCurrent: "03  EN COURS",
      statusPending: "03  À VENIR",
    },
  ] as const;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto"
      style={{
        background: "rgba(6,9,17,0.78)",
        // Figma desktop (1680×970): top = 124px when viewport fits card+chrome.
        // Short viewports (e.g. PW 1280×720): shrink top padding (floor 16px) so the
        // 702×726 card can scroll and "Accéder au projet" stays reachable.
        // clamp(16px, 100vh − 726 − 24, 124px) → 124px @970h, 16px @720h.
        padding: "clamp(16px, calc(100vh - 726px - 24px), 124px) 16px 24px",
      }}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="sas-create-progress-title"
      data-testid="sas-create-progress-popup"
    >
      <div
        className="relative overflow-y-auto"
        style={{
          width: 702,
          // Contractual Figma card 702×726; maxHeight only engages when viewport is short.
          height: 726,
          maxHeight: "calc(100vh - 40px)",
          maxWidth: "calc(100vw - 32px)",
          background: "#1b2639",
          border: "1px solid #2b3850",
          borderRadius: 18,
          color: "#f3f5ff",
        }}
        data-testid="sas-create-progress-card"
      >
        <div
          aria-hidden
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            height: 4,
            background: "#7477ed",
          }}
        />

        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3" style={{ padding: "28px 35px 0" }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="relative" style={{ width: 52, height: 52 }} aria-hidden>
              {/* Native Figma SVGs — preserve root width/height attributes */}
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img src={ASSET.halo} alt="" width={52} height={52} />
              <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={ASSET.analyse} alt="" width={30} height={30} />
              </span>
            </div>
            <p
              className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-[#7477ed]"
              data-testid="sas-create-progress-kicker"
              data-outcome={outcome}
            >
              {kicker}
            </p>
          </div>
          <span
            className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold"
            style={{ background: "#17382f", borderColor: "#6cdbba", color: "#6cdbba" }}
          >
            ✓ Créé
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ padding: "24px 35px 0" }}>
          <h2
            id="sas-create-progress-title"
            className="text-[28px] font-semibold leading-tight"
          >
            {titleText}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-3 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-[#a3b0c7]">{leadText}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="mx-[35px] mt-6 h-px bg-[#2b3850]" />

        <p
          className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#a3b0c7]"
          style={{ padding: "18px 35px 0" }}
        >
          SUIVI DE LA PRÉPARATION
        </p>

        <ol className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-[11px]" style={{ padding: "0 35px" }}>
          {steps.map((item) => {
            const done = complete || displayStep > item.n;
            const current = !complete && displayStep === item.n;
            const statusLabel = done
              ? item.statusDone
              : current
                ? item.statusCurrent
                : item.statusPending;
            const statusColor = done ? "#6cdbba" : current ? "#7477ed" : "#7787a4";
            const borderColor = current ? "#7477ed" : "#2b3850";
            const minH = current ? 104 : item.n === 1 ? 79 : 86;

            return (
              <li
                key={item.n}
                className="relative flex gap-4 rounded-[12px] border"
                style={{
                  background: "#151d2c",
                  borderColor,
                  minHeight: minH,
                  padding: "15px 18px",
                }}
                data-testid={`sas-create-step-${item.n}`}
                data-current={current ? "1" : "0"}
              >
                <div className="relative shrink-0" style={{ width: 35, height: 35, marginTop: 4 }} aria-hidden>
                  {done ? (
                    <>
                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                      <img src={ASSET.confirmCircle} alt="" width={35} height={35} />
                      <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                        <img src={ASSET.confirmIcon} alt="" width={22} height={22} />
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : current ? (
                    <>
                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                      <img src={ASSET.focusHalo} alt="" width={35} height={35} />
                      <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                        <img src={ASSET.evaluation} alt="" width={19} height={19} />
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="relative">
                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                      <img src={ASSET.wait} alt="" width={35} height={35} />
                      <span
                        className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#a3b0c7]"
                      >
                        {String(item.n).padStart(2, "0")}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pr-24">
                  <p className="text-[16px] font-semibold text-[#f3f5ff]">{item.title}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[#a3b0c7]">{item.detail}</p>
                </div>
                <p
                  className="absolute right-[18px] top-[17px] text-[10px] font-semibold"
                  style={{ color: statusColor }}
                >
                  {statusLabel}
                </p>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>

        <div
          className="mx-[35px] mt-4 flex gap-3 rounded-[10px] border border-[#2b3850] bg-[#151d2c] px-4 py-3"
          style={{ minHeight: 67 }}
        >
          {/* RB-09 — fixed square box so the info glyph stays circular under flex. */}
          <span
            className="mt-0.5 inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center"
            style={{ width: 22, height: 22, flex: "0 0 22px" }}
            aria-hidden
          >
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img
              src={ASSET.info}
              alt=""
              width={22}
              height={22}
              style={{ width: 22, height: 22, objectFit: "contain", display: "block" }}
            />
          </span>
          <p className="text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-[#a3b0c7]">
            Tu peux quitter Studio : cette préparation sera retrouvée à ton retour.
          </p>
        </div>

        {props.qualification?.composerLockReason ? (
          <p className="mx-[35px] mt-3 text-xs text-[#a3b0c7]">
            {props.qualification.composerLockReason}
          </p>
        ) : null}

        <div
          className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4"
          style={{ padding: "22px 35px 32px", position: "sticky", bottom: 0, background: "#1b2639" }}
          data-testid="sas-create-progress-footer"
        >
          <p className="text-[12px] text-[#7787a4] min-w-0 flex-1">
            Aucun cycle ne démarre sans ton accord.
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn primary shrink-0"
            onClick={props.onDismiss}
            data-testid="sas-create-progress-dismiss"
            style={{ width: 190, minHeight: 44, borderRadius: 9 }}
          >
            Accéder au projet
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  --fig-bg: #0b101b;

.fig-card-desc {
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  flex: 1;
}

.fig-card-meta {
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.fig-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.fig-tag-ok { background: var(--fig-ok-bg); color: var(--fig-ok); }
.fig-tag-muted { background: var(--fig-tag); color: var(--fig-muted); }
.fig-tag-warn { background: var(--fig-warn-bg); color: var(--fig-warn); }
.fig-tag-accent { background: rgba(101, 111, 225, 0.16); color: var(--fig-accent-soft); }
.fig-tag-info { background: var(--fig-info-bg); color: #9dbcff; }

.fig-banner {
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: var(--fig-radius);
  padding: 16px 18px;
  background: #121826;
}
.fig-banner h3 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}
.fig-banner p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.fig-workspace {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.45fr) minmax(280px, 0.7fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}

/* Figma 652:8 — conversation ~968 / aside ~369 / gap ~25 at 1680×970 */
.fig-travail-workspace {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 968fr) minmax(260px, 369fr);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 25px;
  align-items: stretch;
  min-height: 0;
}

/* Participates in .project-travail-stage grid (intro | rule | conversation | composer × inspector). */
.fig-travail-workspace-embed {
  display: contents;
}

.fig-conversation-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  background: #151c29;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 18px 20px 16px;
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 3;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.fig-travail-workspace > .fig-conversation-panel {
  grid-row: 1;
}

.fig-conversation-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.fig-nora-thread {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.fig-msg {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 13px;
  padding: 14px 18px 16px;
  background: #0f1420;
}

.fig-msg-pilot {
  background: #292d58;
  margin-left: clamp(0px, 12%, 180px);
}

.fig-msg-nora {
  background: #0f1420;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  margin-right: clamp(0px, 8%, 120px);
}

.fig-msg-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.fig-msg-avatar {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #292d58;
  color: #afa5ff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.fig-msg-role {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #afa5ff;
}

.fig-msg-role-pilot {
  color: #afa5ff;
}

.fig-msg-body {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #f4f6fc;
  font-weight: 400;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.fig-msg-body .safe-md,
.fig-msg-body pre,
.fig-msg-body code {
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.fig-msg-body p {
  margin: 0 0 0.55em;
}

.fig-msg-body p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Stage / workspace grid cell: composer + optional pending (CP01). */
.fig-travail-composer-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 4;
  /* start — never align-self:end with a short grid row (paints upward over the thread). */
  align-self: start;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: visible;
}

.fig-travail-composer-stack[data-pending="1"] {
  /*
   * Desktop (2-col): conversation is minmax(0,1fr) and yields space; stack may
   * scroll internally on very short heights without leaving the shell lock.
   * Avoid overflow:auto alone without a definite height — it under-sizes the
   * grid row and overlaps the conversation in single-column breakpoints.
   */
  max-height: min(50vh, 360px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  /* Include full pending+composer in grid max-content contribution. */
  min-height: min-content;
}

.fig-travail-workspace > .fig-travail-composer-stack {
  grid-row: 2;
}

.fig-travail-pending {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: #151c29;
}

.fig-travail-pending-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.fig-travail-composer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: #151c29;
  /* Figma page 05 compact composer ≈ 84px; grows upward into thread space. */
  min-height: 84px;
  max-height: min(40vh, 320px);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.fig-travail-composer-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.fig-travail-composer-plus {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  color: #94a2bb;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  /* Visual affordance only — attachments/dictation not operational in E05. */
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.fig-travail-composer-input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 24px;
  max-height: min(36vh, 280px);
  resize: none;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #f4f6fc;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  padding: 6px 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}

.fig-travail-composer-input::placeholder {
  color: #94a2bb;
}

.fig-travail-composer-input:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.fig-travail-composer-input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.fig-travail-composer-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid #272e49;
}

.fig-travail-composer-hint {
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.fig-travail-composer-send {
  width: 44px;
  height: 35px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #656fe1;
  color: #f4f6fc;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

/* Ensemble 05 — choices, activity, viewer */
.fig-nora-choices {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.fig-nora-choice {
  border: 1px solid #3a4470;
  background: #1a2033;
  color: #f4f6fc;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.fig-nora-choice:disabled {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: default;
}

.fig-nora-choice:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent-soft);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.fig-nora-choices-expired {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  width: 100%;
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.fig-nora-refs {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  padding-left: 0;
  list-style: none;
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-size: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.fig-nora-ref-link {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #afa5ff;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}

.fig-nora-ref-link:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent-soft);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Figma 12.01 / 12.10 — Activité Nora LIVE (functional, not SDK dump) */
.fig-nora-live-activity {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 730px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line, #2b3850);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 20px;
  background: var(--fig-panel, #151d2c);
  color: var(--fig-text, #f3f5ff);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-accent, #7477ed);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 29px;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border-radius: 15px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line, #2b3850);
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg, #242c4b);
  color: var(--fig-amber, #e6ba76);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-badge .fig-nora-live-activity-pulse {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--fig-accent, #7477ed);
  animation: fig-nora-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-step-limited {
  color: var(--fig-amber, #e6ba76);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-step-failed {
  color: #e08a8a;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-headline {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: var(--fig-text, #f3f5ff);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-lead,
.fig-nora-live-activity-footnote {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-muted, #a3b0c7);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-steps {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-step {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fig-text, #f3f5ff);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-step-current {
  color: var(--fig-accent, #7477ed);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-step-pending {
  color: var(--fig-muted, #a3b0c7);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-mark {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 1.1em;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-groups {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-group-toggle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  padding: 6px 0;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-group-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-group-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f3f5ff;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-group-result {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-chevron {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  color: #7787a4;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding-top: 2px;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-details {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0 0 4px 1.6em;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-details li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: baseline;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #f3f5ff;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-group-failed .fig-nora-live-activity-group-title {
  color: #f5a8a8;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-group-limited .fig-nora-live-activity-group-title {
  color: #e6c07b;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-sources {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid #2b3850;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-sources-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #7787a4;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-sources ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-sources li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: baseline;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #f3f5ff;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-source-cov {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #6cdbba;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-detail {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-muted, #a3b0c7);
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-detail summary {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.fig-nora-live-activity-detail ul {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding-left: 18px;
}

.fig-nora-activity {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: #151c29;
  color: #f4f6fc;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.fig-nora-activity-pulse {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #656fe1;
  animation: fig-nora-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.fig-nora-activity-note {
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-size: 11px;
  width: 100%;
}

@keyframes fig-nora-pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.35;
    transform: scale(0.85);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .fig-nora-activity-pulse {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.fig-nora-activity-history {
  margin-top: 10px;
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.fig-nora-activity-history summary {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.fig-travail-viewer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background: #151c29;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.fig-travail-viewer-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 16px 18px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #272e49;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.fig-travail-viewer-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.fig-travail-viewer-meta {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.fig-travail-viewer-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 16px 18px 20px;
}

.fig-travail-viewer-pre {
  margin: 0;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #f4f6fc;
}

.fig-travail-composer-send:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.fig-travail-composer-send:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent-soft);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.fig-travail-aside {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / -1;
  align-self: stretch;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: #0f1420;
  isolation: isolate;
  z-index: 2;
  position: relative;
}

.fig-inspector {
  background: #151c29;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px 22px 22px;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

.fig-inspector-title {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: #f4f6fc;
}

.fig-inspector-name {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fc;
}

.fig-inspector-section {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #94a2bb;
}

.fig-inspector-rule {
  height: 1px;
  background: #272e49;
  margin: 16px 0;
}

.fig-inspector-card {
  background: #0f1420;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.fig-inspector-card-title {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fc;
}

.fig-inspector-card-body {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #94a2bb;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.fig-inspector-links {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.fig-inspector-link {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: #afa5ff;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}

/* —— Sas Nora composition (Figma 607:3…607:277) —— */
.sas-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sas-stage {
  margin: 0 0 0.85rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sas-stage-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-accent);
  line-height: 16px;
}

.sas-stage-title {
  margin: 0.55rem 0 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.55rem, 2.1vw, 1.94rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.sas-stage-sub {
  margin: 0.65rem 0 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 22px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  max-width: 51rem;
}

.sas-workspace {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, var(--sas-conversation-w)) minmax(280px, var(--sas-preview-w));
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: stretch;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  /* Fill remaining shell height — do not cap at Figma 655px (caused empty bottom band). */
  height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sas-workspace > * {
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: 100%;
}

.sas-thread {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sas-thread-scroll {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-right: 4px;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

.sas-resume-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  min-height: 51px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-accent-deep);
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.sas-msg {
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: var(--fig-radius-sm);
  padding: 16px 18px 18px;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
}

.sas-msg-pilot {
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
}

.sas-msg-nora-emphasis {
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
  border-color: var(--fig-accent-deep);
}

.sas-msg-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
}

.sas-msg-avatar {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sas-msg-avatar-nora {
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
  color: var(--fig-accent);
  border-radius: 7px;
}

.sas-msg-avatar-pilot {
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.sas-msg-role {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.sas-msg-role-nora { color: var(--fig-accent); }
.sas-msg-role-pilot { color: var(--fig-muted); }

.sas-msg-body {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.sas-msg-body .safe-md,
.sas-msg-body pre,
.sas-msg-body code {
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.sas-msg-body p { margin: 0 0 0.55rem; }
.sas-msg-body p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

.sas-thread-status {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-info) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: var(--fig-info-bg);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #c9d7ff;
}

.sas-thread-status-error {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 55%, var(--fig-line));
}

.sas-composer {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: var(--sas-composer-h);
  min-height: var(--sas-composer-h);
  max-height: var(--sas-composer-h);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: var(--fig-radius);
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  padding: 14px 16px 10px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.sas-composer-input {
  width: 100%;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 42px;
  resize: none;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  padding: 0;
  outline: none;
}

.sas-composer-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
}

.sas-composer-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sas-composer-hint {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.sas-composer-plus {
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.sas-composer-send {
  width: 48px;
  height: 30px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--fig-accent);
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sas-composer-send:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.sas-composer-send:focus-visible,
.sas-composer-input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sas-preview {
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sas-preview-inner {
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  padding: 18px 20px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: var(--fig-radius);
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  overflow: auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.sas-preview-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.sas-preview-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.sas-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 29px;
  padding: 0 13px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sas-badge-muted {
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}
.sas-badge-amber {
  background: var(--fig-warn-bg);
  color: var(--fig-warn);
}
.sas-badge-green {
  background: var(--fig-ok-bg);
  color: var(--fig-ok);
}
.sas-badge-accent {
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
  color: var(--fig-accent);
}

.sas-preview-title {
  margin: 1rem 0 0;
  font-size: 23px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 33px;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}

.sas-preview-sub {
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 17px;
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
}

.sas-preview-sections {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
}

.sas-preview-section {
  padding: 0.85rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
}

.sas-preview-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
  line-height: 15px;
}

.sas-preview-value {
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.sas-preview-value.is-quiet { color: var(--fig-quiet); }
.sas-preview-value.is-amber { color: var(--fig-warn); }

.sas-preview-provenance {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
}

.sas-preview-open-extra {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0 0.35rem;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
}

.sas-maturity {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.sas-maturity-ok {
  background: var(--fig-ok-bg);
  border-color: var(--fig-ok);
}

.sas-maturity-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 19px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.sas-maturity-ok .sas-maturity-title {
  color: var(--fig-ok);
}

.sas-maturity-body {
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 17px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.sas-preview-adjust {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  align-self: flex-start;
}

.sas-create-block {
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

/* Frame 04 emphasis when Nora reports base_sufficient — still not a create gate. */
.sas-create-block-ready .sas-create-btn {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-ok) 45%, transparent);
}

.sas-create-btn {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 49px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-accent);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: var(--fig-accent-deep);
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.sas-create-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.sas-create-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sas-create-hint {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  text-align: center;
}

.sas-preview-foot {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 17px;
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
}

.sas-preview-meta {
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
}

.sas-secondary-tools {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.sas-project-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 29px;
  padding: 0 13px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .sas-workspace {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(260px, 0.85fr);
    gap: 20px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .sas-workspace {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .sas-preview-inner {
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .sas-composer {
    position: sticky;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 2;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .sas-stage-title {
    font-size: 1.35rem;
  }
  .sas-preview-title {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
}

.fig-workspace-3 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(300px, 0.85fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}

/* Ensemble 06 — Documents page 08 (1680×970: list ~928 / aside ~414 ≈ 70/30) */
.doc-workspace-7030 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 928fr) minmax(300px, 414fr);
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: stretch;
  min-height: 634px;
}

.doc-panel {
  background: #151c2b;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 24px 22px;
  min-height: 0;
}

.doc-panel-list,
.doc-panel-read {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.doc-panel-aside {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.doc-panel-list-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.doc-panel-heading {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f5f6fe;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.doc-panel-count {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #7889a6;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.doc-search {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  height: 49px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
  background: #101624;
}

.doc-search-icon {
  color: #a3b0c7;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.doc-search input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 0;
  outline: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: #f5f6fe;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.doc-search input::placeholder {
  color: #7889a6;
}

.doc-card-list,
.doc-version-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  flex: 1;
}

.doc-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 107px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
  background: #101624;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: inherit;
}

.doc-card:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent) 45%, #29334b);
}

.doc-card:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent-soft);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.doc-card-selected {
  background: #252d52;
  border-color: var(--fig-accent);
}

.doc-card-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.doc-card-title {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f5f6fe;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.doc-card-sub {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #a3b0c7;
}

.doc-card-chevron {
  color: #7889a6;
  font-size: 22px;
  margin-left: 12px;
}

.doc-panel-footnote {
  margin: auto 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #7889a6;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.doc-aside-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #b2b4ff;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.doc-aside-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f5f6fe;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.doc-aside-divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: #29334b;
  margin: 4px 0;
}

.doc-meta-block {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.doc-meta-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #7889a6;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.doc-meta-value {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f5f6fe;
}

.doc-aside-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.doc-action {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 49px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}

.doc-action:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.doc-action:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent-soft);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.doc-action-primary {
  background: var(--fig-accent);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-accent);
  color: #fff;
}

.doc-action-secondary {
  background: #101624;
  border: 1px solid #303b54;
  color: #e5eaf8;
}

.doc-provenance {
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid #29334b;
}

.doc-read-body {
  overflow: auto;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: 560px;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.doc-version-row {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 124px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
  background: #101624;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: inherit;
}

.doc-version-row-selected {
  background: #272f53;
  border-color: var(--fig-accent);
}

.doc-version-row:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fig-accent-soft);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.doc-version-row-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.doc-version-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f5f6fe;
}

.doc-version-excerpt {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.doc-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 120px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.doc-badge-current {
  background: #1d372f;
  color: #b2dec7;
}

.doc-badge-historical {
  background: #222b42;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
}

.doc-compare-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.doc-select-label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #7889a6;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.doc-select {
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
  background: #101624;
  color: #f5f6fe;
  padding: 0 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.doc-compare-hint {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #7889a6;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.doc-compare-workspace {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.doc-compare-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.doc-compare-toolbar .doc-action {
  max-width: 348px;
}

.doc-compare-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 17px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.doc-compare-col {
  min-height: 500px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.doc-compare-doc-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f5f6fe;
}

.doc-diff-removed {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: #292334;
  border: 1px solid #744659;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #f5f6fe;
}

.doc-diff-added {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: #1b3236;
  border: 1px solid #407b76;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #f5f6fe;
}

.doc-compare-summary {
  background: #151c2b;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  min-height: 110px;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .doc-workspace-7030,
  .doc-compare-columns {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.doc-historical-confirm {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #29334b;
  background: #151c2b;
}

.doc-historical-confirm-text {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.doc-historical-confirm-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.doc-historical-confirm-actions .doc-action {
  width: auto;
  min-width: 280px;
  max-width: 348px;
}

.doc-proposal-conserve {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #3d4f2f;
  background: #152015;
}

.doc-proposal-conserve-badge {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: #d4e8a8;
}

.doc-badge-proposal {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 22%, transparent);
  color: #f0d878;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 45%, transparent);
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.fig-panel {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 92%, black);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: var(--fig-radius);
  padding: 16px 18px;
}

.fig-panel-title {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.fig-kicker {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

/* Message / composer base — Travail overrides in .fig-travail-* above */
.fig-msg {
  border-radius: 13px;
  padding: 14px 18px 16px;
  background: #0f1420;
}
.fig-msg-pilot { background: #292d58; }
.fig-msg-nora { background: #0f1420; border: 1px solid #272e49; }

.fig-composer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px;
  background: #151c29;
}

/* C24 / Figma 12.09 — retirable D8 dossier reference above the draft. */
.fig-dossier-attachment {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid #3a4270;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #1a2236;
}
.fig-dossier-attachment-body {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}
.fig-dossier-attachment-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #c5c9e8;
}
.fig-dossier-attachment-meta {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: #8b93b5;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.fig-dossier-attachment-remove {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 1px solid #7477ed66;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #a8acf0;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.fig-dossier-attachment-remove:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: #7477ed;
  color: #d0d3ff;
}
.fig-dossier-attachment-remove:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* O-06 — long-thread composer remains reachable while the journal scrolls. */
.fig-nora-thread-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 0;
}
.fig-composer-sticky {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  background: #0c1018;
}

.fig-two-col {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 800fr) minmax(0, 510fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.fig-empty-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.fig-empty-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.fig-empty-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }

.fig-alert {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-info) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: var(--fig-info-bg);
  border-radius: var(--fig-radius-sm);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #c9d7ff;
}

/* UX-004 portfolio composition */
.fig-stat-value-text {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.fig-card-sep {
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--fig-line);
  width: 100%;
}

.portfolio-project-card {
  min-height: 180px;
}

.portfolio-empty-projects {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: flex-start;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  padding: 1.35rem 1.25rem;
  min-height: 160px;
}

.portfolio-empty-glyph {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 58px;
  height: 58px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent) 22%, transparent);
  color: var(--fig-accent-soft);
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.portfolio-empty-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.portfolio-empty-copy {
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  max-width: 42rem;
}

.portfolio-prep-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
}

.portfolio-prep-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  min-height: 66px;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
}

.portfolio-prep-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #272e49;
  color: var(--fig-accent-soft);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.portfolio-prep-title {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}

.portfolio-prep-meta {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
}

.portfolio-prep-resume {
  min-width: 7.5rem;
}

.portfolio-empty-preps {
  min-height: 91px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.portfolio-continuity h3 {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .fig-stat-grid,
  .fig-card-grid,
  .fig-workspace,
  .fig-travail-workspace,
  .fig-workspace-3,
  .fig-two-col {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .fig-nora-thread {
    max-height: none;
  }

  .fig-msg-pilot,
  .fig-msg-nora {
    margin-left: 0;
    margin-right: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .fig-stat-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .fig-stat-access {
    display: none;
  }
  .fig-card-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .portfolio-project-card {
    min-height: 86px;
  }
  .portfolio-prep-row {
    min-height: 75px;
    padding-left: 0.85rem;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--fig-accent);
  }
  .portfolio-prep-icon {
    display: none;
  }
  .portfolio-prep-resume {
    min-width: auto;
    padding-inline: 0.55rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .fig-page { gap: 18px; }
  .fig-hero-title { font-size: 1.35rem; }
  /* Frames 282:468 / 282:492 are Figma artboards at 390×1350 — natural reflow + scroll */
  .fig-nora-responsive {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .fig-nora-responsive .fig-panel {
    max-height: none;
  }
  .fig-composer {
    position: sticky;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 2;
  }
}

/* Ensemble 04 — project space chrome (Figma 652:*); no secondary tab strip. */
.project-space-page {
  gap: 20px;
}

.project-space-page--travail {
  min-height: 0;
  gap: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.project-space-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 70px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  background: #0a0e17;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

.project-space-header--breadcrumb-only {
  min-height: 70px;
  height: 70px;
  gap: 0;
  padding: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: #0a0e18;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #273148;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 3;
}

/* Figma 09.* surface heroes — fixed native sizes (no clamp drift). */
.e07-surface-hero {
  padding-top: 41px; /* header 70 → kicker y=111 */
  margin: 0;
}

.e07-surface-hero .fig-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}

.e07-surface-hero-title {
  margin: 14px 0 0;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 37px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--fig-ink, #f3f5ff);
  /* Page 10 hero title box — 55px native (was 52 → Δy panels) */
  min-height: 55px;
  height: 55px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.e07-surface-hero-sub {
  margin: 5px 0 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--fig-muted, #a3b0c7);
  max-width: 52rem;
  min-height: 51px; /* Figma description box */
}

.e07-section-rule {
  margin-top: 13px; /* Figma: desc end ~256 → sep 269 */
  margin-bottom: 19px; /* Page 10 Projet: sep 269 → panel 289 (Δ0) */
  height: 1px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1358px;
  background: #2b3850;
}

.project-overview,
.trajectory-board,
.trajectory-cki {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  max-width: 1358px;
}

/* Trajectoire / CKI Page 10: first panel at y≈287 after sep 269. */
.trajectory-board > .e07-section-rule,
.trajectory-cki > .e07-section-rule {
  margin-bottom: 17px; /* 269 + 1 + 17 = 287 */
}

/* Spacing between panels after the hero rule (not between hero parts). */
.trajectory-board > .e07-section-rule ~ * + *,
.trajectory-cki > .e07-section-rule ~ * + * {
  margin-top: 7px; /* Page 10: parcours end → cycle actif y≈500 */
}

/* Projet: only the first panel follows the rule; activity spacing is explicit. */
.project-overview > .e07-section-rule + * {
  margin-top: 0;
}

/* Keep shared hero box heights so Trajectoire/CKI first panel lands at y≈287
   (Page 10). Shorter copy still occupies the contracted description box. */

.project-space-breadcrumb {
  min-height: 28px;
}

.project-space-badge {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-accent-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  background: rgba(101, 111, 225, 0.12);
}

.project-space-kicker {
  color: #afa5ff;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.project-space-hero-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px 14px;
}

.project-space-hero .fig-hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.55rem, 2vw, 1.95rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 0;
}

.project-space-hero .fig-hero-sub {
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.4;
  max-width: 56rem;
}

/* Compact Travail intro — same surface as page, no aplat. */
.fig-travail-intro {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}

.fig-travail-intro-rule {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 2;
  height: 1px;
  width: 100%;
  background: #272e49;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  border: 0;
}

.project-travail-stage {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 968fr) minmax(260px, 369fr);
  grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  column-gap: 25px;
  /* Figma conversation→composer gap ≈ 25px; intro→rule stays compact via rule margin. */
  row-gap: 25px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

/* Ensemble 05 / CT-06 — 50/50 of useful area outside rail (Figma 701:363 ≈ 668/668). */
.project-travail-stage[data-travail-layout="split"] {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: 22px;
}

/* Enlarged viewer: conversation/composer hidden; aside spans useful area.
 * Cause (T05): React `hidden` alone left grid items cohabiting the same column —
 * conversation text could paint through/behind the viewer. CSS must remove them
 * from layout, and the aside must be an opaque isolated stacking context. */
.project-travail-stage[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.project-travail-stage[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] > .fig-travail-intro,
.project-travail-stage[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] > .fig-travail-intro-rule {
  display: none;
}

.project-travail-stage[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] .fig-conversation-panel,
.project-travail-stage[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] .fig-travail-composer-stack,
[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] .fig-conversation-panel,
[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] .fig-travail-composer-stack {
  display: none !important;
}

.project-travail-stage[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] .fig-travail-aside,
[data-travail-layout="enlarged"] .fig-travail-aside {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1 / -1;
  background: #0f1420;
  isolation: isolate;
  z-index: 3;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
}

.fig-travail-intro-rule {
  margin-top: 0;
  /* Pull rule closer under intro (override uniform 25px track gap for rows 1→2). */
  translate: 0 -13px;
}

.project-travail-stage > .fig-travail-composer-stack {
  margin-top: 0;
  align-self: start;
  justify-self: stretch;
}

.project-space-page .fig-tag {
  font-weight: 600;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .project-space-page--travail {
    height: auto;
    max-height: none;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  .project-travail-stage {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto;
    row-gap: 16px;
  }

  .fig-travail-intro,
  .fig-travail-intro-rule,
  .fig-conversation-panel,
  .fig-travail-composer-stack,
  .fig-travail-aside {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: auto;
  }

  /*
   * Stacked layout already unlocks page overflow. Let the grid row grow to
   * pending+composer so controls never overlay the conversation panel.
   */
  .fig-travail-composer-stack[data-pending="1"] {
    max-height: none;
    overflow-y: visible;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  .fig-conversation-panel {
    min-height: 280px;
    max-height: min(60vh, 520px);
  }

  .fig-travail-aside {
    max-height: none;
  }
}

/* Ensemble 05 / T02+consolidation — native visual composition */
.fig-visual-composition {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 0;
}

.fig-visual-block {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0;
}

.fig-visual-comparison,
.fig-visual-sequence,
.fig-visual-relations,
.fig-visual-synthesis {
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #121826;
  padding: 14px 16px 16px;
}

.fig-visual-text {
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.fig-visual-text-head {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

/* UX-01 — icon optically centered on the first text line (not stacked, not high). */
.fig-visual-text-with-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
}
.fig-visual-text-icon {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  /* 16px glyph vs ~15px/1.35 first line → ~2px optical settle */
  margin-top: 2px;
  height: 1.35em;
}
.fig-visual-text-icon .fig-visual-icon {
  margin-right: 0;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.fig-visual-text-body {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
.fig-visual-text-body > :first-child {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
}
.fig-visual-text-body > :first-child > :first-child {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
}
.fig-visual-text-observation,
.fig-visual-text-hypothesis,
.fig-visual-text-risk,
.fig-visual-text-recommendation {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border-left: 3px solid #3d5aa8;
  background: #121826;
}

.fig-visual-text-hypothesis {
  border-left-color: #c9a45c;
}

.fig-visual-text-risk {
  border-left-color: #8a3f4a;
}

.fig-visual-text-recommendation {
  border-left-color: #7b8cff;
}

.fig-visual-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  margin-right: 8px;
  color: #9aa6c3;
  vertical-align: -3px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.fig-visual-icon-fact {
  color: #6ea8ff;
}

.fig-visual-icon-hypothesis {
  color: #c9a45c;
}

.fig-visual-icon-risk {
  color: #e08a96;
}

.fig-visual-icon-recommend {
  color: #7b8cff;
}

.fig-visual-title {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #f4f6fc;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
}
.fig-visual-title > .fig-visual-icon {
  margin-top: 2px;
  margin-right: 0;
  height: 1.35em;
}
.fig-visual-title > span {
  min-width: 0;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.fig-visual-recommendation {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.fig-visual-recommendation > .fig-visual-icon {
  margin-top: 2px;
  margin-right: 0;
  height: 1.35em;
}

.fig-visual-recommendation-body {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
.fig-visual-recommendation-body > :first-child {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
}
.fig-visual-recommendation-body > :first-child > :first-child {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
}

.fig-visual-inline-md {
  display: block;
  margin: 0;
}

.fig-visual-inline-md p {
  display: inline;
  margin: 0;
}

.fig-visual-inline-md p + p {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.45em;
}

.fig-visual-inline-md ul,
.fig-visual-inline-md ol {
  margin: 0.4em 0 0;
  padding-left: 1.2em;
}

.fig-visual-step-body h4 {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #e8ecf8;
}

.fig-visual-step-deps {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.fig-visual-choices-anchor,
.fig-visual-refs-anchor {
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.fig-visual-comparison-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}

.fig-visual-alt {
  border: 1px solid #2a334d;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: #0f1420;
}

.fig-visual-alt h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #e8ecf8;
}

.fig-visual-alt p,
.fig-visual-step-body p,
.fig-visual-synth-item p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #b7c0d8;
}

.fig-visual-pros,
.fig-visual-cons,
.fig-visual-relations-list,
.fig-visual-relations-edges,
.fig-visual-synthesis-list,
.fig-visual-provenance {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding-left: 1.1rem;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #9aa6c3;
}

.fig-visual-matrix-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.fig-visual-matrix {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.fig-visual-matrix th,
.fig-visual-matrix td {
  border: 1px solid #2a334d;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  text-align: left;
  color: #c5cee6;
}

.fig-visual-matrix th {
  background: #181f2f;
  color: #e8ecf8;
}

.fig-visual-recommendation {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-left: 3px solid #7b8cff;
  background: #171d2c;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #d7def2;
}

.fig-visual-recommendation-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #9aa6c3;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.fig-visual-steps {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
}

.fig-visual-step {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: 10px;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
}

.fig-visual-step-marker {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #243056;
  color: #e8ecf8;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.fig-visual-step-connector {
  position: absolute;
  left: 13px;
  top: 28px;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: #2a334d;
}

.fig-visual-step-deps,
.fig-visual-step-date {
  margin: 4px 0 0 !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  color: #8e9bb8 !important;
}

.fig-visual-relations-svg {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 420px;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto 8px;
}

.fig-visual-edge {
  stroke: #3a4666;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.fig-visual-edge-label {
  fill: #8e9bb8;
  font-size: 9px;
}

.fig-visual-node {
  fill: #1a2236;
  stroke: #4a5a84;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.fig-visual-node-fact,
.fig-visual-node-finding {
  stroke: #6ea8ff;
}

.fig-visual-node-observation {
  stroke: #7a93c4;
}

.fig-visual-node-hypothesis {
  stroke: #c9a45c;
}

.fig-visual-node-cause {
  stroke: #d4877a;
}

.fig-visual-node-unknown {
  stroke: #7a849e;
  stroke-dasharray: 3 2;
}

.fig-visual-node-label {
  fill: #d7def2;
  font-size: 8px;
}

.fig-visual-tone {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  color: #9aa6c3;
}

.fig-visual-synth-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #0f1420;
  border: 1px solid #272e49;
  list-style: none;
}

.fig-visual-synthesis-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.fig-visual-tone-priority {
  border-color: #3d5aa8;
}

.fig-visual-tone-risk {
  border-color: #8a3f4a;
}

.fig-visual-tone-watch {
  border-color: #6a5a2e;
}

.fig-visual-tone-finding {
  border-color: #2f5a4a;
}

.fig-visual-synth-tone {
  width: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  color: #b7c0d8;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.fig-visual-provenance {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #7f8aa8;
}

.fig-visual-provenance-note {
  color: #6d7894;
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .fig-visual-comparison-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Conversational composition v1 — adaptive presentation (CV-*) */
.fig-comp-composition {
  container-type: inline-size;
  container-name: nora-composition;
}

.fig-comp-title {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.fig-comp-alt h4,
.fig-comp-alt p,
.fig-comp-step h4,
.fig-comp-fallback-text,
.fig-comp-matrix th,
.fig-comp-matrix td {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: break-word;
  white-space: normal;
}

.fig-comp-comparison-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.fig-comp-matrix-details {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.fig-comp-matrix-details-title {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-comp-relations-label {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.fig-comp-complement {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.fig-comp-authority-note {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-quiet);
}

.fig-comp-deps-nodes,
.fig-comp-parallel-tasks,
.fig-comp-tree-root,
.fig-comp-tree-branches {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.fig-comp-deps-canvas {
  position: relative;
}

.fig-comp-deps-svg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: visible;
  z-index: 1;
}

.fig-comp-deps-connector {
  fill: none;
  stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 70%, var(--fig-line));
  stroke-width: 1.75;
}

.fig-comp-deps-arrowhead {
  fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 70%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-deps-layers {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 28px;
}

.fig-comp-deps-layer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.fig-comp-deps-node,
.fig-comp-tree-node {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 88%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-deps-layer .fig-comp-deps-node {
  margin: 0;
  flex: 1 1 160px;
  min-width: min(100%, 140px);
}

.fig-comp-deps-edges {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-left: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 70%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-deps-edges li {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.fig-comp-deps-arrow {
  margin: 0 6px;
  color: var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.fig-comp-deps-rel {
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-lanes {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-lane {
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-lane-title {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-comp-parallel-sync,
.fig-comp-parallel-edges {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-left: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 70%, transparent);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-edges li {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.fig-comp-tree-branches {
  margin: 6px 0 0 16px;
  padding-left: 10px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--fig-line);
}

.fig-comp-tree-condition {
  display: block;
  margin: 4px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-comp-relations-detail {
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.fig-comp-comparison-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.fig-comp-matrix-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.fig-comp-matrix {
  width: max-content;
  min-width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.fig-comp-matrix th,
.fig-comp-matrix td {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
  white-space: normal;
}

.fig-comp-steps-vertical {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
}

.fig-comp-steps-horizontal {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.fig-comp-steps-horizontal > .fig-comp-step {
  flex: 1 1 180px;
  min-width: min(100%, 180px);
}

.fig-comp-relations-svg {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.fig-comp-relations-svg .fig-visual-node-label {
  font-size: 10px;
}

.fig-comp-block-fallback,
.fig-comp-fallback-text {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--fig-line);
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 80%, transparent);
}

/* C2 — complementary substance under substitute (visible, not sr-only) */
.fig-comp-substance-complement {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-left: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 72%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-substance-complement-label {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-comp-substance-complement-text {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}

/* W3 — Figma-oriented hierarchy on Studio dark tokens (adaptive, not pixel-fixed) */
.fig-comp-comparison-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.fig-comp-comparison-cards .fig-comp-alt,
.fig-comp-comparison-stack .fig-comp-alt {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  border-top: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 65%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 90%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-comparison-cards .fig-comp-alt h4,
.fig-comp-comparison-stack .fig-comp-alt h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 15px;
}

.fig-comp-authority-note {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-comp-tree-root,
.fig-comp-tree-branches {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.fig-comp-tree-branches {
  margin: 8px 0 0 18px;
  padding-left: 14px;
  border-left: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 45%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-tree-condition {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 22%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 40%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-tree-node {
  align-items: center;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-lane {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 85%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-parallel-lane-title {
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-edges {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-left: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-visual-recommendation {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-left: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 70%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 78%, transparent);
}

@container nora-composition (max-width: 560px) {
  .fig-comp-comparison-cards {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .fig-comp-steps-horizontal {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .fig-comp-parallel-lanes {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .fig-comp-tree-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
}

/* W3 — measured graph canvas (Figma 07–09 orientation, dark Studio) */
.fig-comp-graph-canvas {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.fig-comp-graph-svg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  overflow: visible;
}

.fig-comp-tree-connected .fig-comp-tree-row,
.fig-comp-parallel-connected .fig-comp-parallel-lanes,
.fig-comp-parallel-connected .fig-comp-parallel-task,
.fig-comp-tree-connected .fig-comp-tree-card {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.fig-comp-tree-connected {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.fig-comp-tree-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px 24px;
  padding: 10px 4px 18px;
}

.fig-comp-tree-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: min(220px, 100%);
  max-width: 320px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 80%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 92%, #0a121c);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 4%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-tree-branch-root {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 14%, var(--fig-panel));
}

.fig-comp-tree-branch-yes {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #3d8f6e 50%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-tree-branch-no {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #a86b4a 50%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-tree-branch-yes::before,
.fig-comp-tree-branch-no::before {
  content: attr(data-branch);
  position: absolute;
  top: -9px;
  left: 12px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-comp-tree-branch-yes::before {
  content: "Si oui";
  color: color-mix(in srgb, #7dcea0 80%, var(--fig-ink));
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #3d8f6e 45%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-tree-branch-no::before {
  content: "Si non";
  color: color-mix(in srgb, #d4a574 80%, var(--fig-ink));
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #a86b4a 45%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-parallel-connected .fig-comp-parallel-lanes {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-task {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 75%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 88%, transparent);
  list-style: none;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-tasks {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-lane-gate {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 12%, var(--fig-panel));
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.fig-comp-parallel-lane {
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 70%, transparent);
}

/* W3 — Figma 01 editorial synthesis */
.fig-comp-synthesis-editorial .fig-comp-synth-flow {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.fig-comp-synth-section-title {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-comp-synth-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  /* UX-06 — internal left padding so icons never kiss the frame edge */
  padding: 12px 14px 12px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 55%, transparent);
}
.fig-nc-residual-items {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 70%, transparent);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel, #121826) 88%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-synth-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.fig-comp-synth-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}

.fig-comp-synth-detail {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-ink) 82%, var(--fig-muted));
}

.fig-comp-synth-priorities {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border-left: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 70%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 10%, var(--fig-panel));
}

.fig-comp-synth-hypotheses {
  padding: 4px 0 4px 12px;
  border-left: 2px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-muted) 55%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-comp-synth-risks .fig-comp-synth-label {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, #d4a574 70%, var(--fig-ink));
}

/* W3 — stronger sequence path (Figma 02/06) */
.fig-comp-steps-vertical .fig-comp-step {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 8px;
}

.fig-comp-steps-vertical .fig-visual-step-marker {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 28%, var(--fig-panel));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}

.fig-comp-steps-vertical .fig-visual-step-connector {
  width: 2px;
  min-height: 16px;
  margin: 4px 0 4px 13px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 60%, transparent),
