    color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 80%, transparent)
  );
}

.fig-comp-steps-horizontal {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px 4px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.fig-comp-steps-horizontal .fig-comp-step {
  flex: 1 1 160px;
  min-width: 140px;
  max-width: 280px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 75%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 90%, transparent);
}

.fig-comp-steps-horizontal .fig-visual-step-connector {
  align-self: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 2px;
  margin: 0 2px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  flex: 0 0 24px;
}

/* New graphical subsystem — nora-composition (not E05 artisan) */
.fig-nc-graph-node {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 80%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 92%, #0a121c);
}
.fig-nc-graph-node-plain {
  gap: 0;
}

.fig-nc-graph-node-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}

.fig-nc-graph-node-detail {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-ink) 80%, var(--fig-muted));
}

.fig-nc-graph-node-status {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-nc-graph-node-yes {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #3d8f6e 45%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-nc-graph-node-no {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #a86b4a 45%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-nc-graph-node-gate,
.fig-nc-graph-node-emphasis {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 12%, var(--fig-panel));
}

.fig-nc-node-flow,
.fig-nc-parallel-tasks {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.fig-nc-parallel-lanes {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.fig-nc-parallel-lane {
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 70%, transparent);
}

.fig-nc-parallel-lane-gate {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent, #3a6ea5) 55%, var(--fig-line));
}

.fig-nc-engine-note {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}

.fig-nc-elk-canvas-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: visible;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.fig-nc-elk-canvas {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  min-height: 48px;
}

.fig-nc-elk-svg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: visible;
}

/* Fixed + off-viewport: real typography boxes for ELK measure, without
   expanding the board's layout/screenshot bounding box. */
.fig-nc-measure-layer {
  position: fixed;
  left: -10000px;
  top: 0;
  width: 280px;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.fig-nc-measure-node {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.fig-nc-relations {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.fig-nc-edges-a11y {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.fig-nc-elk-node .fig-nc-graph-node {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Comparison cards — denser Figma-oriented surfaces */
.fig-comp-comparison-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.fig-comp-comparison-cards .fig-comp-alt,
.fig-comp-comparison-stack .fig-comp-alt {
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 75%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 90%, #0a121c);
}

.fig-comp-matrix-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 70%, transparent);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.fig-comp-matrix {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.fig-comp-matrix th,
.fig-comp-matrix td {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-line) 55%, transparent);
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.fig-comp-matrix thead th {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-panel) 80%, transparent);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.project-unavailable {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding-top: 2rem;
}

.project-overview .fig-panel {
  background: var(--fig-panel);
}

/* ─── Figma 01–06 editorial convergence (2026-11-18) ─── */
.fig-nc-fixture-badge {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-editorial-hero { margin-bottom: 18px; }
.fig-nc-editorial-headline {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.2vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.fig-nc-editorial-headline-primary {
  display: block;
  color: var(--fig-text, #f4f6fb);
}
.fig-nc-editorial-headline-accent {
  display: block;
  color: #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-editorial-lead {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 52rem;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--fig-muted, #a8b2c5);
}
.fig-nc-indicators {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 0;
  margin: 18px 0 28px;
  padding: 16px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #29344a;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #29344a;
}
.fig-nc-indicators-divider {
  width: 1px;
  margin: 4px 28px;
  background: #1d293b;
  align-self: stretch;
}
.fig-nc-indicator-value {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 27px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fb;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
.fig-nc-indicator-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #a8b2c5;
}
.fig-nc-editorial-section { margin: 28px 0; }
.fig-nc-section-head {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: baseline;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.fig-nc-section-head-plain {
  gap: 0;
}
.fig-nc-section-num {
  /* retained for legacy markup; UX-03 no longer emits decorative section ordinals */
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #e8bc86;
  min-width: 1.6rem;
}
.fig-nc-section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fb;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .fig-nc-strategy-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .fig-nc-indicators-divider { display: none; }
  .fig-nc-indicators { gap: 16px; }
  .fig-nc-indicator { flex: 1 1 40%; }
}
.fig-nc-strategy-card {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 15px;
  border: 1px solid #36445d;
  background: #172237;
  padding: 20px 22px 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  /* Natural content height — no artificial vertical stretch (UX-07 sibling). */
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-gold { border-color: #4b456b; background: #201e32; }
.fig-nc-strategy-accent {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; top: 0; right: 0;
  height: 4px;
  background: #71a9e6;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-gold .fig-nc-strategy-accent { background: #e8bc86; }
.fig-nc-strategy-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-eyebrow {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #71a9e6;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-gold .fig-nc-strategy-eyebrow { color: #e8bc86; }
.fig-nc-strategy-mono {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #71a9e6 18%, transparent);
  color: #71a9e6;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 18px;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-gold .fig-nc-strategy-mono {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #e8bc86 18%, transparent);
  color: #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-title {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fb;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-summary {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: #a8b2c5;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-footer {
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid #29344a;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-positive {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #f4f6fb;
}
.fig-nc-strategy-counterpart {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #708299;
}
.fig-nc-checklist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.fig-nc-checklist-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 12px minmax(120px, 180px) 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: start;
  padding: 12px 0;
}
.fig-nc-checklist-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-checklist-row:nth-child(2) .fig-nc-checklist-dot { background: #71a9e6; }
.fig-nc-checklist-row:nth-child(3) .fig-nc-checklist-dot { background: #8585ff; }
.fig-nc-checklist-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fb;
}
.fig-nc-checklist-detail {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #a8b2c5;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.fig-nc-orientation {
  margin-top: 22px;
  padding: 12px 0 4px 14px;
  border-left: 3px solid #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-orientation-label {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-orientation-body {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #f4f6fb;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* Comparison option cards (Figma 03/05) — UX-07 natural flow, top-aligned */
.fig-nc-option-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 0;
  height: auto;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  align-items: stretch;
  padding: 22px 20px !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  border: 1px solid #2a3650 !important;
  background: #172237 !important;
}
.fig-nc-option-eyebrow {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-option-title {
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fb;
}
.fig-nc-option-summary {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #adb9cf;
  /* Do not flex-grow — avoids artificial mid-card gaps (UX-07). */
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.fig-nc-option-vigilance {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #7e8ea5;
}
.fig-comp-comparison-cards {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}
.fig-comp-comparison-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}
.fig-comp-comparison-stack .fig-nc-option-card {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .fig-comp-comparison-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* Editorial matrix (Figma 04) — options as rows, readable cells */
.fig-nc-matrix-editorial {
  border: 1px solid #2b364a;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #111b2b;
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}
.fig-nc-matrix-rows {
  border-collapse: separate;
  border-spacing: 0;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 640px;
  table-layout: fixed;
}
.fig-nc-matrix-rows thead th {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #7e8ea5;
  background: #0f1826;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2b364a;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: normal;
  word-break: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.fig-nc-matrix-rows thead th:first-child { width: 22%; }
.fig-nc-matrix-rows thead th:nth-child(2) { width: 28%; }
.fig-nc-matrix-rows tbody th,
.fig-nc-matrix-rows tbody td {
  padding: 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2b364a;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: #adb9cf;
  vertical-align: top;
  white-space: normal;
  word-break: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  hyphens: manual;
}
.fig-nc-matrix-rows tbody th {
  color: #f4f6fb;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.fig-nc-matrix-opt-label {
  display: inline-block;
  white-space: normal;
}

/* Sequence horizontal (Figma 02) — four cards share the Travail column */
.fig-nc-h-steps {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 8px 0 0;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
}
.fig-nc-h-step {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.fig-nc-h-step-link {
  width: 12px;
  height: 2px;
  margin: auto 0;
  background: #29344a;
  flex: 0 0 12px;
}
.fig-nc-h-step-card {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 185px;
  padding: 28px 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 15px;
  border: 1px solid #29344a;
  background: #161f31;
}
.fig-nc-h-step-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -1px; top: -1px; right: -1px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0;
  background: #e8bc86;
}
.fig-nc-h-step-medallion {
  position: absolute;
  top: -16px;
  right: 14px;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #e8bc86;
  color: #16151b;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.fig-nc-h-step-card h5 {
  margin: 18px 0 8px;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fb;
}
.fig-nc-h-step-card p,
.fig-nc-h-step-card .fig-visual-inline-md {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #a8b2c5;
}

/* Timeline (Figma 02) — shared week grid for head + bars */
.fig-nc-timeline-caption {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #a8b2c5;
}
.fig-nc-timeline {
  border: 1px solid #29344a;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #111b2b;
  padding: 14px 16px 10px;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-head,
.fig-nc-timeline-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 150px) minmax(360px, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  min-width: 520px;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-head {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-label-col {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #a8b2c5;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-weeks,
.fig-nc-timeline-track {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--tl-weeks, 8), minmax(40px, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
  width: 100%;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-week {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #708299;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 2px;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-track {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 30px;
  background: #1a2737;
  border-radius: 7px;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-bar {
  grid-row: 1;
  margin: 2px 1px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-left: 3px solid currentColor;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 15%, transparent);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  min-width: 0;
}
.fig-nc-timeline-blue { color: #71a9e6; }
.fig-nc-timeline-violet { color: #8585ff; }
.fig-nc-timeline-gold { color: #e8bc86; }
.fig-nc-timeline-teal { color: #63cdb4; }
.fig-nc-timeline-footnote {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #708299;
}

/* Vertical editorial steps (Figma 06) */
.fig-nc-v-steps {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.fig-nc-v-step {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 22px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2b364a;
}
.fig-nc-v-step:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.fig-nc-v-step-num {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #e8bc86;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
.fig-nc-v-step-body h5 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f4f6fb;
}
.fig-nc-v-step-body .fig-visual-inline-md,
.fig-nc-v-step-body p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #a8b2c5;
}

/* Ensemble 06 — Journal V4 (Figma 835:71 / 842:* / 860:*) */
.project-space-page--journal {
  --journal-ink: #f4f6fd;
  --journal-muted: #96a2ba;
  --journal-muted-2: #6f7e96;
  --journal-line: #273049;
  --journal-panel: #151c2a;
  --journal-panel-2: #101523;
  --journal-accent: #7172ea;
  --journal-accent-soft: #ada5ff;
  --journal-accent-2: #827cff;
  --journal-banner: #1e2544;
  /* Figma 1680×970: header 70 + viewer y=95 → height 832 → bottom ~43 */
  --journal-viewer-w: 784px;
  --journal-compact-w: 526px;
  --journal-split-gap: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  gap: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.project-space-page--journal > .project-journal,
.project-space-page--journal [data-testid="project-journal"] {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
}
.journal-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: var(--journal-split-gap);
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  height: 100%;
}
.journal-layout-full .journal-main-column {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1330px;
}
.journal-layout-split .journal-main-column {
  flex: 0 0 var(--journal-compact-w);
  width: var(--journal-compact-w);
  max-width: var(--journal-compact-w);
  min-width: 280px;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.journal-layout-enlarged .journal-main-column {
  display: none;
}
.journal-main-column {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
}
.journal-main-column .journal-hierarchy,
.journal-main-column .journal-decision-list,
.journal-main-column .journal-results-list,
.journal-main-column .journal-open-points-list,
.journal-main-column [data-testid="journal-search-results"],
.journal-main-column [data-testid="journal-open-points-list-wrap"] {
  /* Grow with content; scroll only when exceeding available column height — avoid tall empty card for 1 sujet. */
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  max-height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  align-self: stretch;
}
.journal-v4-head {
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}
.journal-v4-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--journal-accent-soft);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.journal-v4-title-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
}
.journal-v4-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 31px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--journal-ink);
}
.journal-v4-sub {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--journal-muted);
  max-width: 52rem;
}
.journal-layout-split .journal-v4-sub {
  font-size: 14px;
}
.journal-v4-back-thread {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
  background: var(--journal-panel-2);
  color: var(--journal-muted);
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.journal-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 48px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  position: relative;
}
.journal-tab {
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--journal-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 0 0 14px;
  margin: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.journal-tab.is-active {
  color: var(--journal-ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  background: transparent;
}
.journal-tab.is-active::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: -1px;
  width: 73px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--journal-accent);
}
.journal-tab[data-testid="journal-tab-decisions"].is-active::after {
  width: 80px;
}
.journal-search-wrap {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.journal-search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 18px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--journal-muted);
  font-size: 22px;
  pointer-events: none;
  line-height: 1;
}
.journal-search {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  height: 55px;
  padding: 0 18px 0 56px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
  background: var(--journal-panel-2);
  color: var(--journal-ink);
  font-size: 14px;
}
.journal-search::placeholder {
  color: var(--journal-muted);
}
.journal-section-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.journal-section-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--journal-muted);
}
.journal-section-hint {
  margin: 0;
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--journal-muted-2);
}
.journal-section-bar .journal-section-label {
  margin-right: auto;
}
.journal-filter-open {
  appearance: none;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  background: #131c2d;
  color: #b9b0ff;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.journal-filter-open.is-active {
  border-color: var(--journal-accent);
  background: #1e2544;
}
.journal-hierarchy {
  border: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--journal-panel);
  padding: 8px 0;
  min-height: 120px;
}
.journal-empty-copy {
  margin: 24px 28px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--journal-muted);
  max-width: 36rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
/* C10 — empty panel fits content; do not stretch to shell bottom */
.journal-hierarchy.journal-empty,
.journal-empty[data-testid="journal-empty-structure"] {
  flex: 0 0 auto !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  height: auto !important;
  max-height: none;
  overflow: visible;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}
.journal-layout-full .journal-hierarchy.journal-empty {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 52rem;
}
.journal-group {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
}
.journal-group:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.journal-group-head,
.journal-child-row,
.journal-decision-row {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--journal-ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
}
.journal-group-head {
  padding: 18px 22px 16px;
}
.journal-group.is-selected > .journal-group-head,
.journal-child-row.is-selected,
.journal-decision-row.is-selected,
.journal-result-row.is-selected,
.journal-open-point-row.is-selected {
  background: #242d4b;
  position: relative;
}
.journal-group.is-selected > .journal-group-head::before,
.journal-child-row.is-selected::before,
.journal-decision-row.is-selected::before,
.journal-result-row.is-selected::before,
.journal-open-point-row.is-selected::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 12px;
  width: 3px;
  height: calc(100% - 24px);
  min-height: 45px;
  max-height: 49px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--journal-accent);
}
.journal-expand {
  flex: 0 0 28px;
  color: var(--journal-accent-soft);
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.journal-expand.is-leaf-mark {
  color: var(--journal-muted-2);
  font-size: 16px;
}
.journal-group-text {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.journal-group-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--journal-ink);
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.journal-group.is-leaf .journal-group-title,
.journal-child-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.journal-child-title {
  color: var(--journal-ink);
}
.journal-row-desc {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--journal-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.journal-axes {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--journal-accent-soft);
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.journal-open-arrow {
  flex: 0 0 20px;
  color: var(--journal-muted-2);
  font-size: 15px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.journal-open-badge,
.journal-match {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  margin-right: 8px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  background: #1e2544;
  color: #b9b0ff;
}
.journal-children {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 18px 10px 52px;
  position: relative;
}
.journal-children::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 36px;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 12px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--journal-line);
}
.journal-child-row {
  padding: 12px 8px 12px 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
  position: relative;
}
.journal-child-row::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 22px;
  width: 14px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--journal-line);
}
.journal-grandchildren {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0 0 18px;
}
.journal-child-row.is-nested {
  font-size: 14px;
}
.journal-decision-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
}
.journal-decision-row {
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: 118px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  background: var(--journal-panel);
}
.journal-decision-main {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.journal-decision-title {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f6f7ff;
}
.journal-decision-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #99a8c6;
}
.journal-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 29px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  background: #131c2d;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #c8d1e4;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.journal-status-dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #99a8c6;
}
.journal-status-ok .journal-status-dot {
  background: #9dd9c9;
}
.journal-status-warn .journal-status-dot {
  background: #efce96;
}
.journal-viewer {
  /* Figma 853:42 — 784×832 at x=830 y=95 */
  flex: 0 0 var(--journal-viewer-w);
  width: var(--journal-viewer-w);
  max-width: var(--journal-viewer-w);
  min-width: var(--journal-viewer-w);
  margin-left: auto;
  align-self: stretch;
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  border-radius: 17px;
  background: #141c2b;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.journal-layout-enlarged .journal-viewer {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1330px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
}
.journal-viewer-banner {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 14px 14px 0;
  padding: 16px 24px 18px 24px;
  min-height: 181px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border-radius: 15px;
  border: 1px solid #444d7a;
  background: var(--journal-banner);
  overflow: hidden;
}
/* Figma 853:44 — Liseré lumière 3×112, offset under banner top */
.journal-viewer-banner::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 29px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 112px;
  border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
  background: var(--journal-accent-2);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.journal-layout-enlarged .journal-viewer-banner {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1330px;
  min-height: 198px;
  border-radius: 16px;
}
.journal-layout-enlarged .journal-viewer-banner::before {
  /* Figma 854:43 — rail identité 4×124 */
  left: 0;
  top: 31px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 124px;
}
.journal-viewer-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #b9b0ff;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.journal-viewer-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f6f7ff;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.journal-viewer-lede {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #dce4f4;
}
.journal-viewer-type {
  display: inline-flex;
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  border: 1px solid #414c6a;
  background: #21294a;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #dce4f4;
}
.journal-viewer-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.journal-viewer-btn {
  appearance: none;
  height: 33px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid #414c6a;
  background: #12192d;
  color: #dce4f4;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.journal-viewer-close {
  width: 32px;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 18px;
}
.journal-viewer-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 14px;
}
.journal-viewer-layout {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
.journal-layout-enlarged .journal-viewer-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 936px) 374px;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: start;
}
.journal-viewer-article {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.journal-viewer-aside {
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #131c2d;
  padding: 22px 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  min-height: 0;
}
.journal-layout-split .journal-viewer-aside {
  display: none;
}
.journal-aside-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #b9b0ff;
}
.journal-aside-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f6f7ff;
}
.journal-aside-sep {
  height: 1px;
  background: #35415c;
  border: 0;
  margin: 4px 0;
}
.journal-aside-meta-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #99a8c6;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}
.journal-aside-meta-value {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #f6f7ff;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.journal-aside-meta-desc {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #99a8c6;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.journal-card {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #182234;
  padding: 16px 18px;
}
.journal-card-synthesis {
  overflow: visible;
}
/*
 * Figma 853:58 / 860:413 — accent bar at ~17px from card left;
 * body text starts ~32px. Bar must never overlap glyphs.
 */
.journal-card-synthesis::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 14px;
  top: 46px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 58px;
  max-height: calc(100% - 56px);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--journal-accent-2);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}
.journal-card-synthesis > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.journal-card-synthesis .journal-card-kicker {
  padding-left: 0;
}
.journal-card-synthesis .journal-acquis-line,
.journal-card-synthesis .journal-muted,
.journal-card-synthesis [data-testid="journal-subject-summary"],
.journal-card-synthesis [data-testid="journal-subject-summary-empty"],
.journal-card-synthesis .markdown,
.journal-card-synthesis p {
  padding-left: 18px;
  margin-left: 0;
}
.journal-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #b9b0ff;
}
.journal-card-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
}
.journal-card-half {
  background: #131c2d;
  border-radius: 13px;
}
.journal-bullet-list {
  list-style: disc;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0 0 1.15rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.journal-acquis-line,
.journal-open-line {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #f6f7ff;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.journal-overflow {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #99a8c6;
}
.journal-overflow > summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: disclosure-closed;
}
.journal-overflow[open] > summary {
  list-style: disclosure-open;
}
.journal-overflow .journal-bullet-list {
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.journal-muted {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #99a8c6;
}
.journal-warn {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #efce96;
}
.journal-breadcrumb {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #99a8c6;
}
.journal-child-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.journal-child-card {
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 31px minmax(0, 1fr) 24px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #131c2d;
  color: #f6f7ff;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  text-align: left;
  min-height: 58px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.journal-child-num {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 31px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #1e2544;
  color: #b9b0ff;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.journal-child-card-text {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}
.journal-child-card-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f6f7ff;
}
.journal-child-card-desc {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #99a8c6;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.journal-child-link {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: #f6f7ff;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: left;
}
.journal-results-list,
.journal-open-points-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 8px 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--journal-panel);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.journal-result-row,
.journal-open-point-row {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--journal-line);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--journal-ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 16px 22px;
  position: relative;
}
.journal-result-row:last-child,
.journal-open-point-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.journal-result-title,
.journal-open-point-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f6f7ff;
}
.journal-result-path,
.journal-open-point-origin {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #99a8c6;
}
.journal-result-reason {
  display: inline-block;
  width: fit-content;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  background: #1e2544;
  color: #b9b0ff;
}
.journal-results-count {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--journal-muted);
}
.journal-parent-note {
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #182234;
  padding: 18px 22px;
}
.journal-parent-note p {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #dce4f4;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.journal-restriction-list {
  list-style: disc;
  padding-left: 1.2rem;
  margin: 0;
  color: #c8d1e4;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.journal-source-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.journal-decision-meta-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .journal-decision-meta-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
.journal-decision-sources-cta {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid #35415c;
  background: #1e2544;
  border-radius: 11px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  color: #f6f7ff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}
.journal-decision-sources-cta:hover {
  border-color: #827cff;
}
.journal-source-chip {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  background: #131c2d;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  color: #dce4f4;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.journal-source-chip:disabled {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.journal-source-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 8px 12px;
}
.journal-source-author {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #e8eefc;
}
.journal-source-when {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #99a8c6;
}
.journal-source-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #99a8c6;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.journal-source-excerpt {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #c8d1e4;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.journal-source-cta {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #b9b0ff;
}
.journal-contradiction-block {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.journal-contradiction-pair {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.journal-continue {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid #3c486c;
  background: #1c2540;
  border-radius: 11px;
  padding: 14px 16px 14px 20px;
  color: #eef0ff;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  overflow: hidden;
}
/* Figma 855:43 — Poursuivre barre 3×29 */
.journal-continue::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 18px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 29px;
  border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
  background: var(--journal-accent-2);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.journal-continue-cta {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.fig-msg.is-journal-focus,
.fig-msg[data-journal-focus="1"] {
  outline: 2px solid var(--journal-accent-soft);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  background: #1e2544;
}
@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .journal-layout-split .journal-main-column {
    flex-basis: 42%;
    width: 42%;
    max-width: none;
  }
  .journal-card-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .journal-group-title {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
}

/* ——— Dépôts Git (page 11 / E08 consultation) ——— */
.git-repos-surface {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1358px;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}
.git-error {
  color: #f0a8a8;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #5a1f1f 40%, var(--fig-panel));
  border: 1px solid #6e3030;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin: 0;
}
.git-muted { color: var(--fig-muted); font-size: 12px; margin: 0; }
.git-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; word-break: break-all; }
.git-btn-primary,
.git-btn-secondary,
.git-btn-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
}
.git-btn-primary {
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent) 40%, var(--fig-line));
}
.git-btn-icon {
  width: 42px;
  padding: 0;
}
.git-btn-secondary.is-disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.git-badge-ok {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  background: var(--fig-ok-bg);
  color: var(--fig-ok);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.git-badge-soft {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  width: fit-content;
}
.git-info-anchor {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
}
.git-info-popover {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  right: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  max-height: min(70vh, 420px);
  overflow: auto;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px color-mix(in srgb, #000 35%, transparent);
}
.git-info-popover-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.git-info-popover-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.git-empty-layout,
.git-manage,
.git-enlarge-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.git-empty-main,
.git-manage-main,
.git-enlarge-preview {
  flex: 1 1 62%;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 22px 22px 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.git-empty-side,
.git-manage-side,
.git-enlarge-details {
  flex: 0 0 492px;
  max-width: 492px;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 22px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.git-side-label {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
}
.git-repo-card {
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 20px 22px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.git-repo-card-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
}
.git-repo-fullname {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.git-branch-wrap { position: relative; }
.git-branch-select {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 37px;
  padding: 8px 11px 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.git-branch-menu {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 20;
  top: calc(100% + 4px);
  left: 0;
  min-width: 180px;
  max-height: 240px;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 6px;
  list-style: none;
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.git-branch-menu button {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.git-branch-menu button:hover,
.git-branch-menu button[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
}
.git-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 37px;
  align-items: center;
}
.git-tabs button {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.git-tabs button.is-active {
  color: var(--fig-accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.git-split-3070 {
  display: flex;
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
}
.git-tree-panel {
  flex: 0 0 30%;
  max-width: 406px;
  min-width: 260px;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 20px 22px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 545px;
}
.git-preview-panel {
  flex: 1 1 70%;
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 20px 22px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 545px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.git-tree-panel h2,
.git-pubs h2,
.git-manage-main h2,
.git-unavailable h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.git-tree-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  overflow: auto;
  max-height: 420px;
}
.git-tree-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 39px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  padding-right: 10px;
}
.git-tree-row.is-selected {
  background: var(--fig-accent-bg);
  color: var(--fig-ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.git-tree-note { margin-top: auto; }
.git-tree-up {
  align-self: flex-start;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--fig-accent);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 0;
}
.git-preview-head {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.git-preview-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.git-preview-path {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}
.git-preview-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}
.git-preview-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-accent);
}
.git-preview-body {
  overflow: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1;
}
.git-preview-pre {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
  margin: 0;
}
/* Figma 11.17 — Aperçu indisponible (générique, pas limité au PDF) */
.git-preview-unavailable {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 0;
  min-height: 320px;
  padding: 28px 24px 24px;
  border: 1px solid #2c374e;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #111826;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.git-preview-unavailable-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 68px;
  height: 68px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #353967;
  background: #222847;
}
.git-preview-unavailable-motif {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #7a7bf6;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.git-preview-unavailable-title {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-text, #f3f5ff);
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.git-preview-unavailable-message,
.git-preview-unavailable-hint {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 668px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--fig-muted, #a3b0c7);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.git-preview-unavailable-hint {
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.git-preview-unavailable-cta {
  margin-top: 28px;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 170px;
  justify-content: center;
}
.git-preview-unavailable-note {
  margin: 16px 0 0;
  max-width: 596px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #808daa;
}
.git-details-list,
.git-details-inline {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0;
}
.git-details-list dt,
.git-details-inline dt {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fig-muted);
}
.git-details-list dd,
.git-details-inline dd {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
}
.git-pubs,
.git-unavailable {
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 22px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.git-pubs-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.git-pubs-list li {
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.git-pubs-item {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.git-pubs-item.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--fig-accent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fig-accent) 12%, var(--fig-panel-hi));
}
.git-pubs-path { margin: 0 0 6px; font-weight: 600; }
.git-pubs-status { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--fig-ok); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.git-refs-incomplete {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fig-amber, #e6ba76);
}
.git-branch-menu-wrap {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 20;
  top: calc(100% + 4px);
  left: 0;
  min-width: 280px;
  max-width: 420px;
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.git-branch-search {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
}
.git-branch-filter-input {
  flex: 1 1 160px;
  min-width: 140px;
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi, var(--fig-panel));
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: inherit;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.git-branch-menu-wrap .git-branch-menu {
  position: static;
  max-height: 240px;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.git-manage-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.git-manage-item {
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi);
}
.git-manage-item-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.git-manage-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 11px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.git-modal-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(5, 8, 16, 0.62);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 80;
  padding: 24px;
}
.git-modal {
  width: min(520px, 100%);
  background: var(--fig-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 22px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}
@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .git-split-3070,
  .git-empty-layout,
  .git-manage,
  .git-enlarge-layout {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .git-tree-panel,
  .git-empty-side,
  .git-manage-side,
  .git-enlarge-details {
    max-width: none;
    flex-basis: auto;
    width: 100%;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .git-tabs { gap: 16px; }
  .git-repo-card-row { gap: 10px; }
  .git-preview-head { flex-direction: column; }
}

/* Ensemble 08 — Figma 11.06 Intégrations (node 1095:339) */
.integrations-1106-page {
  /* Shell already provides ~38px inset (Figma content x=284 after rail 246). */
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1358px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 16px 0 32px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.integrations-1106 {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
}

.integrations-1106-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  /* Figma 11.06 header frame h=91 → panels absolute y≈293 with gap 24 + banner 44. */
  gap: 8px;
}

.integrations-1106-eyebrow {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fig-accent, var(--accent));
}

.integrations-1106-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 34px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fig-ink, var(--ink));
}

.integrations-1106-lead {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 1310px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--fig-muted, var(--muted));
}

.integrations-1106-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 14px 17px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 16px;
}

.integrations-1106-banner.is-ok {
  background: var(--fig-ok-bg);
  color: var(--fig-ok, var(--ok));
}

.integrations-1106-banner.is-warn {
  background: var(--fig-warn-bg);
  color: var(--fig-warn, var(--warn));
}

.integrations-1106-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 858fr) minmax(0, 482fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
}

.integrations-1106-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 13px;
  /* Figma 11.06 panels: 610 px at viewport 1680×970; may grow with dynamic repos. */
  min-height: 610px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 20px 21px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line, var(--line));
  background: var(--fig-panel, var(--panel));
}

@media (max-width: 1279px) {
  .integrations-1106-card {
    min-height: 0;
  }
}

.integrations-1106-provider {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.integrations-1106-card-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-ink, var(--ink));
}

.integrations-1106-aside-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-ink, var(--ink));
}

.integrations-1106-connected {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-ok, var(--ok));
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.integrations-1106-muted {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--fig-muted, var(--muted));
}

.integrations-1106-repo-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 13px;
}

.integrations-1106-repo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 13px 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fig-line, var(--line));
  background: var(--fig-panel-hi, #1b2639);
}

.integrations-1106-repo-name {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fig-ink, var(--ink));
  word-break: break-word;
}

.integrations-1106-repo-meta {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--fig-muted, var(--muted));
}

.integrations-1106-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-top: 2px;
}

.integrations-1106-actions .git-btn-secondary,
.integrations-1106-actions .git-btn-primary {
  min-width: 205px;
  min-height: 42px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.integrations-1106-write-note {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--fig-quiet, var(--fig-muted, var(--muted)));
}

.integrations-1106-message {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--fig-warn, var(--warn));
}

@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .integrations-1106-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .integrations-1106-page {
    padding: 12px 0 24px;
  }
  .integrations-1106-title {
    font-size: 28px;
  }
  .integrations-1106-actions .git-btn-secondary,
  .integrations-1106-actions .git-btn-primary {
    min-width: 0;
    width: 100%;
  }
}

/* ─── ML5 C10 — Contract viewer / D6 modal / D8 bilan ─── */

.fig-contract-viewer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: #151d2c;
  border: 1px solid #2b3850;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* C24 fidelity — ContractViewer page 12 composition */
.fig-contract-viewer--page12 {
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 20px;
  overflow: auto;
}
.fig-cv-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.fig-cv-head-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}
.fig-cv-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #7477ed;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.fig-cv-link {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
}
.fig-cv-link:hover { color: #7477ed; }
.fig-cv-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f3f5ff;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.fig-cv-meta {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  line-height: 1.4;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.fig-cv-engagements {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 13px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.fig-cv-engagement-card {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #2b3850;
  background: #1b2639;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
}
.fig-cv-engagement-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #7477ed;
}
.fig-cv-engagement-body {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #f3f5ff;
  line-height: 1.35;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.fig-cv-section-label {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #7477ed;
}
.fig-cv-volets {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.fig-cv-volet {
  background: #1b2639;
  border-radius: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.fig-cv-volet-toggle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  height: 35px;
  padding: 0 13px;

}
.fig-cv-volet-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.fig-cv-volet-plus { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #a3b0c7; }
.fig-cv-volet-body {
  padding: 0 13px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.fig-cv-instruction {
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #2b3850;
  background: #1b2639;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

}
.fig-cv-instruction-link {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #7477ed;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;

.fig-cv-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;

}
.fig-cv-footer-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* Proof cards / bilan page12 */
.fig-proof-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.fig-proof-card {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 12px 13px 11px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid #2b3850;
  background: #1b2639;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.fig-proof-card-rubrique {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #7477ed;
}
.fig-proof-card-fact-strong {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #f3f5ff;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.fig-proof-card-fact {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #a3b0c7;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.fig-bilan-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #f3f5ff;
}
.fig-bilan-appreciations {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

SHA-256 tip: `4b0191e6404875b84153e1a54e100b6dbf1ae95508606a31b1dd463a6107c6fe` · 20049 bytes

```
/**
 * Product-facing Nora activity labels (Figma 12.01 / 12.10).
 * Maps durable activity events to métier copy — never exposes SDK/raw tool dumps.
 * ANNOUNCED ≠ OBSERVED ≠ COMPLETED. FAILED/LIMITED/UNCERTAIN are never success.
 */

export type ActivityLabelInput = {
  phase?: string | null;
  nature?: string | null;
  status?: string | null;
  summary?: string | null;
  sourceRef?: string | null;
  detail?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
};

const PHASE_FALLBACKS: Array<{ match: RegExp; label: string }> = [
  { match: /^nora\.generate$/i, label: "Préparation de la réponse" },
  { match: /^nora\.investigation\.engaged$/i, label: "Investigation engagée" },
  { match: /^nora\.investigation$/i, label: "Investigation en cours" },
  { match: /^nora\.contract\.prepare$/i, label: "Préparation du contrat" },
  { match: /^nora\.objective$/i, label: "Orientation du travail" },
  { match: /^nora\.source\.d4/i, label: "Consultation documentaire" },
  { match: /^nora\.source\.git/i, label: "Consultation Git" },
  { match: /^nora\.source\.web/i, label: "Consultation web publique" },
  { match: /^nora\.source\.history/i, label: "Relecture de l'historique" },
  { match: /^nora\.source\.decision/i, label: "Consultation des décisions" },
  { match: /^nora\.source\.report/i, label: "Consultation d'un rapport" },
  { match: /^nora\.source/i, label: "Consultation de sources" },
];

function looksTechnical(summary: string): boolean {
  return (
    /^(COMPLETE|PARTIAL|DENIED|DISCOVERED|CONSULTED|AVAILABLE|UNAVAILABLE|PAGE_OPENED|STALE|UNKNOWN)\b/i.test(
      summary,
    ) ||
    /\b(doc_|gen_|att_|op_|proj_|prep_|tctr_|efx_|cgw_|nact_|acq_)/i.test(summary) ||
    /^https?:\/\//i.test(summary.trim()) ||
    /OBSERVED:|ANNOUNCED:|COMPLETED:/i.test(summary)
  );
}

/** Shared métier copy for tool-source journal → LIVE activity producers. */
export function formatSourceActivitySummary(entry: {
  kind: string;
  coverage: string;
  title?: string | null;
  ref?: string | null;
  notes?: string | null;
}): string {
  const title = entry.title?.trim() || null;
  const kind = entry.kind.toUpperCase();
  const cov = entry.coverage.toUpperCase();
  let human: string;
  if (kind === "WEB") {
    human =
      cov === "DISCOVERED"
        ? title
          ? `Source web découverte — ${title}`
          : "Source web découverte"
        : cov === "CONSULTED" || cov === "VERIFIED"
          ? title
            ? `Page web consultée — ${title}`
            : "Page web consultée"
          : title
            ? `Recherche web — ${title}`
            : "Recherche web publique";
  } else if (kind === "GIT") {
    human =
      cov === "DISCOVERED"
        ? title
          ? `Source Git découverte — ${title}`
          : "Source Git découverte"
        : cov === "CONSULTED" || cov === "VERIFIED"
          ? title
            ? `Consultation Git — ${title}`
            : "Consultation Git effectuée"
          : cov === "PARTIAL"
            ? title
              ? `Consultation Git partielle — ${title}`
              : "Consultation Git partielle"
            : cov === "DENIED"
              ? title
                ? `Consultation Git refusée — ${title}`
                : "Consultation Git refusée"
              : title
                ? `Consultation Git — ${title}`
                : "Consultation Git";
  } else if (kind === "D4") {
    human =
      cov === "DISCOVERED"
        ? title
          ? `Document identifié — ${title}`
          : "Document identifié"
        : cov === "DENIED"
          ? title
            ? `Document non accessible — ${title}`
            : "Document non accessible"
          : title
            ? `Document consulté — ${title}`
            : "Document consulté";
  } else if (kind === "HISTORY") {
    human = "Historique conversationnel consulté";
  } else {
    human = title || "Consultation de source";
  }
  return human
    .replace(/\b(acq_|cgw_|nact_|gen_|doc_|prep_|proj_)[a-z0-9-]+/gi, "")
    .replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 200);
}

function detailString(
  detail: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
  key: string,
): string | null {
  const v = detail?.[key];
  if (typeof v === "string" && v.trim()) return v.trim();
  return null;
}

function kindFromDetail(detail: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string | null {
  const kind = detail?.kind;
  if (typeof kind === "string" && kind.trim()) return kind.trim().toUpperCase();
  return null;
}

function coverageFrom(input: ActivityLabelInput): string | null {
  const fromDetail = detailString(input.detail, "coverage");
  if (fromDetail) return fromDetail.toUpperCase();
  const summary = (input.summary || "").trim();
  const m = summary.match(
    /^(DISCOVERED|CONSULTED|COMPLETE|PARTIAL|DENIED|STALE|PAGE_OPENED|UNKNOWN)\b/i,
  );
  return m ? m[1]!.toUpperCase() : null;
}

function humanTitle(input: ActivityLabelInput): string | null {
  return (
    detailString(input.detail, "title") ||
    detailString(input.detail, "objective") ||
    detailString(input.detail, "label") ||
    detailString(input.detail, "path") ||
    null
  );
}

function stripCoveragePrefix(summary: string): string {
  return summary
    .replace(
      /^(DISCOVERED|CONSULTED|COMPLETE|PARTIAL|DENIED|STALE|PAGE_OPENED|UNKNOWN)\s*:\s*/i,
      "",
    )
    .trim();
}

function phaseFallback(phase: string): string | null {
  for (const row of PHASE_FALLBACKS) {
    if (row.match.test(phase)) return row.label;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Single-line métier headline for the live activity block.
 * Prefer contextual title/objective/summary over generic phase maps.
 */
export function projectActivityLabel(input: ActivityLabelInput): string {
  const phase = (input.phase || "").trim();
  const summary = (input.summary || "").trim();
  const kind = kindFromDetail(input.detail);
  const coverage = coverageFrom(input);
  const title = humanTitle(input);
  const failed =
    input.status === "FAILED" ||
    input.nature === "UNCERTAIN" ||
    coverage === "DENIED" ||
    input.status === "LIMITED";

  // Prefer non-technical summary when producers already contextualized the event.
  if (summary && !looksTechnical(summary)) {
    const base = summary.slice(0, 160);
    if (failed && input.nature === "UNCERTAIN") return `${base} — limite ou incertitude`;
    if (input.status === "FAILED" || coverage === "DENIED") return `${base} — non abouti`;
    return base;
  }

  if (kind === "WEB" || /web/i.test(phase)) {
    const name = title || stripCoveragePrefix(summary) || null;
    if (coverage === "DISCOVERED" || (/DISCOVERED/i.test(summary) && !/CONSULTED|PAGE_OPENED/i.test(summary))) {
      return name
        ? `Source web découverte — ${name.slice(0, 100)} (non ouverte)`
        : "Source web découverte — page non encore ouverte";
    }
    if (coverage === "CONSULTED" || coverage === "PAGE_OPENED" || /CONSULTED|PAGE_OPENED/i.test(summary)) {
      return name ? `Page web consultée — ${name.slice(0, 110)}` : "Page web consultée";
    }
    if (failed) {
      return name ? `Consultation web limitée — ${name.slice(0, 100)}` : "Consultation web limitée";
    }
    return name ? `Recherche web — ${name.slice(0, 120)}` : "Recherche web publique";
  }

  if (kind === "GIT" || /git/i.test(phase)) {
    const name = title || stripCoveragePrefix(summary) || null;
    if (failed || coverage === "DENIED") {
      return name ? `Consultation Git limitée — ${name.slice(0, 100)}` : "Consultation Git limitée";
    }
    if (input.nature === "ANNOUNCED") {
      return name ? `Consultation Git — ${name.slice(0, 110)}` : "Consultation Git en cours";
    }
    if (input.nature === "COMPLETED" || coverage === "CONSULTED" || coverage === "COMPLETE") {
      return name ? `Consultation Git — ${name.slice(0, 110)}` : "Consultation Git effectuée";
    }
    return name ? `Consultation Git — ${name.slice(0, 110)}` : "Consultation Git en cours";
  }

  if (kind === "D4" || /d4|document/i.test(phase)) {
    const name = title || stripCoveragePrefix(summary) || null;
    if (failed || coverage === "DENIED") {
      return name ? `Document non accessible — ${name.slice(0, 100)}` : "Document non accessible";
    }
    if (input.nature === "ANNOUNCED") {
      return name ? `Consultation du document — ${name.slice(0, 100)}` : "Consultation documentaire";
    }
    return name ? `Document consulté — ${name.slice(0, 110)}` : "Document consulté";
  }

  if (kind === "HISTORY" || /history/i.test(phase)) {
    return "Historique conversationnel consulté";
  }

  const objective = detailString(input.detail, "objective");
  if (objective) {
    if (input.nature === "ANNOUNCED") return objective.slice(0, 160);
    if (failed) return `${objective.slice(0, 140)} — limite`;
  }

  const fromPhase = phase ? phaseFallback(phase) : null;
  if (fromPhase) {
    if (input.nature === "COMPLETED" && fromPhase === "Préparation de la réponse") {
      return "Réponse consolidée";
    }
    if (failed || input.nature === "UNCERTAIN") {
      return `${fromPhase} — limite ou incertitude`;
    }
    if (title && /source|git|document|web/i.test(phase)) {
      return `${fromPhase} — ${title.slice(0, 100)}`;
    }
    return fromPhase;
  }

  if (input.nature === "ANNOUNCED") return "Nora prépare le prochain pas";
  if (input.nature === "OBSERVED") return "Vérification en cours";
  if (input.nature === "COMPLETED") return "Étape terminée";
  if (input.nature === "UNCERTAIN") return "Limite rencontrée";
  return "Activité en cours";
}

export type ActivityStepState = "done" | "current" | "pending" | "limited" | "failed";

export type ActivityStepView = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  state: ActivityStepState;
  nature: string;
  sequence: number;
  sourceRef?: string | null;
};

function authoritativeState(
  ev: ActivityLabelInput & { nature: string },
): ActivityStepState {
  const coverage = coverageFrom(ev);
  if (ev.status === "FAILED" || coverage === "DENIED") return "failed";
  if (ev.status === "LIMITED" || ev.nature === "UNCERTAIN" || coverage === "PARTIAL" || coverage === "STALE") {
    return "limited";
  }
  if (ev.nature === "COMPLETED" || (ev.status === "COMPLETED" && ev.nature !== "ANNOUNCED")) {
    // DISCOVERED alone is not a completed consultation.
    if (coverage === "DISCOVERED") return "current";
    return "done";
  }
  if (ev.nature === "OBSERVED" || ev.nature === "ANNOUNCED") return "current";
  if (ev.status === "RUNNING") return "current";
  return "current";
}

function identityKey(ev: ActivityLabelInput & { sequence: number; nature: string }): string {
  const kind = kindFromDetail(ev.detail) || ev.phase || "step";
  const ref = (ev.sourceRef || detailString(ev.detail, "ref") || "").trim();
  const operation = detailString(ev.detail, "operation") || "";
  // RB-23 — distinct consultations of the same source stay distinct operations.
  if (
    (ev.nature === "OBSERVED" || ev.nature === "COMPLETED") &&
    /source\.(git|d4|web)/i.test(ev.phase || "")
  ) {
    return `${kind}:${ref || "x"}:${operation || "op"}:seq:${ev.sequence}`;
  }
  if (ref) return `${kind}:${ref}`;
  return `${kind}:seq:${ev.sequence}`;
}

export type ActivitySourceView = {
  key: string;
  kind: string;
  title: string;
  coverage: string;
  openUrl?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Unique sources consulted/discovered — independent of operation step count (RB-23).
 */
export function buildActivitySources(
  events: Array<ActivityLabelInput & { sequence: number; nature: string }>,
): ActivitySourceView[] {
  const byRef = new Map<string, ActivitySourceView>();
  for (const ev of events) {
    if (!/source\./i.test(ev.phase || "")) continue;
    const kind = (kindFromDetail(ev.detail) || "OTHER").toUpperCase();
    const ref = (ev.sourceRef || detailString(ev.detail, "ref") || "").trim();
    if (!ref) continue;
    const key = `${kind}:${ref}`;
    const title =
      humanTitle(ev) ||
      stripCoveragePrefix((ev.summary || "").trim()) ||
      "Source";
    const coverage = (coverageFrom(ev) || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();
    const openUrl = detailString(ev.detail, "openUrl");
    const prev = byRef.get(key);
    // Prefer CONSULTED/VERIFIED over DISCOVERED when the same source advances.
    const rank = (c: string) =>
      c === "CONSULTED" || c === "VERIFIED" || c === "COMPLETE"
        ? 3
        : c === "PARTIAL"
          ? 2
          : c === "DISCOVERED"
            ? 1
            : 0;
    if (!prev || rank(coverage) >= rank(prev.coverage)) {
      byRef.set(key, {
        key,
        kind,
        title: title.slice(0, 120),
        coverage,
        openUrl: openUrl || prev?.openUrl || null,
      });
    }
  }
  // No hard drop of known sources — UI folds the list; counters stay truthful.
  return [...byRef.values()];
}

/**
 * Build a short checklist for the Figma activity card from durable events.
 * Dedupes by source/operation identity — never by human label alone.
 * Does NOT rewrite earlier "current" steps to "done" when a new step appears.
 * Filters generic nora.generate when richer source/objective events exist.
 */
export function buildActivitySteps(
  events: Array<ActivityLabelInput & { sequence: number; nature: string }>,
): ActivityStepView[] {
  const hasRich = events.some(
    (e) =>
      /source\./i.test(e.phase || "") ||
      /objective|investigation/i.test(e.phase || ""),
  );
  const filtered = hasRich
    ? events.filter((e) => !/^nora\.generate$/i.test(e.phase || ""))
    : events;
  const byId = new Map<string, ActivityStepView>();
  for (const ev of filtered) {
    const id = identityKey(ev);
    const label = projectActivityLabel(ev);
    const state = authoritativeState(ev);
    const prev = byId.get(id);
    // Later observation for same identity updates state; never invent success.
    byId.set(id, {
      key: id,
      label,
      state,
      nature: ev.nature,
      sequence: ev.sequence,
      sourceRef: ev.sourceRef ?? null,
    });
    // Preserve earliest sequence for stable ordering when updating same identity.
    if (prev && prev.sequence < ev.sequence) {
      byId.get(id)!.sequence = prev.sequence;
    }
  }
  return [...byId.values()].sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence).slice(-8);
}

/** Compact API used by pollers — replaces technical `NATURE: summary` headlines. */
export function compactActivitySummary(
  events: Array<{
    nature: string;
    summary: string;
    status: string;
    phase?: string;
    sourceRef?: string | null;
    detail?: Record<string, unknown>;
  }>,
): { headline: string; detailCount: number } {
  if (events.length === 0) return { headline: "", detailCount: 0 };
  const last = events[events.length - 1]!;
  return {
    headline: projectActivityLabel(last).slice(0, 160),
    detailCount: events.length,
  };
}

export type ActivityGroupView = {
  key: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  state: ActivityStepState;
  /** Compact count line e.g. « 8 fichiers consultés, dont 2 partiellement » */
  resultSummary: string | null;
  details: Array<{
    key: string;
    title: string;
    coverage: string;
    kind: string;
  }>;
};

function groupKeyForPhase(phase: string): string {
  if (/objective|investigation\.engaged/i.test(phase)) return "understand";
  if (/source\.(git|d4|web|history)/i.test(phase)) return "sources";
  if (/contract\.prepare|document|d4\.|pending|conserv/i.test(phase)) return "produce";
  if (/generate|restitution|complete/i.test(phase)) return "restitute";
  return "work";
}

const GROUP_META: Record<string, { title: string; description: string }> = {
  understand: {
    title: "Compréhension du besoin",
    description: "Orientation du travail à partir de la demande du Pilote.",
  },
  sources: {
    title: "Consultation des sources",
    description: "Documents, Git et historiques réellement mobilisés.",
  },
  produce: {
    title: "Production et validation",
    description: "Préparation documentaire, candidat ou enregistrement.",
  },
  restitute: {
    title: "Restitution",
    description: "Consolidation de la réponse pour le Pilote.",
  },
  work: {
    title: "Travail en cours",
    description: "Opérations observées pendant le tour.",
  },
};

/**
 * Hierarchical métier groups for LIVE activity (AT-01).
 * Adaptive: only groups with real events appear. Details stay foldable in UI.
 * Caps synthetic list length; never drops sources from the underlying journal.
 */
export function buildActivityGroups(
  events: Array<ActivityLabelInput & { sequence: number; nature: string; status: string }>,
): ActivityGroupView[] {
  const sources = buildActivitySources(events);
  const byGroup = new Map<string, typeof events>();
  for (const ev of events) {
    const gk = groupKeyForPhase(ev.phase || "");
    const list = byGroup.get(gk) || [];
    list.push(ev);
    byGroup.set(gk, list);
  }
  const order = ["understand", "sources", "produce", "restitute", "work"];
  const groups: ActivityGroupView[] = [];
  for (const key of order) {
    const list = byGroup.get(key);
    if (!list?.length) continue;
    const meta = GROUP_META[key] || GROUP_META.work!;
    let worst: ActivityStepState = "done";
    for (const ev of list) {
      const st = authoritativeState(ev);
      if (st === "failed") worst = "failed";
      else if (st === "limited" && worst !== "failed") worst = "limited";
      else if (st === "current" && worst === "done") worst = "current";
    }
    let resultSummary: string | null = null;
    let details: ActivityGroupView["details"] = [];
    if (key === "sources") {
      const consulted = sources.filter((s) =>
        ["CONSULTED", "VERIFIED", "COMPLETE"].includes(s.coverage),
      ).length;
      const partial = sources.filter((s) => s.coverage === "PARTIAL").length;
      const denied = sources.filter((s) => s.coverage === "DENIED").length;
      const discovered = sources.filter((s) => s.coverage === "DISCOVERED").length;
      const bits: string[] = [];
      if (sources.length) bits.push(`${sources.length} source${sources.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
      if (consulted) bits.push(`${consulted} consultée${consulted > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
      if (partial) bits.push(`${partial} partielle${partial > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
      if (denied) bits.push(`${denied} inaccessible${denied > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
      if (discovered && !consulted) bits.push(`${discovered} identifiée${discovered > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
      resultSummary = bits.join(", ") || null;
      details = sources.map((s) => ({
        key: s.key,
        title: s.title,
        coverage: s.coverage,
        kind: s.kind,
      }));
    } else {
      const steps = buildActivitySteps(list);
      resultSummary =
        steps.length > 1 ? `${steps.length} opérations observées` : steps[0]?.label || null;
      details = steps.slice(0, 40).map((s) => ({
        key: s.key,
        title: s.label,
        coverage: s.state.toUpperCase(),
        kind: "STEP",
      }));
    }
    groups.push({
      key,
      title: meta.title,
      description: meta.description,
      state: worst,
      resultSummary,
      details,
    });
  }
  return groups;
}

/**
 * Mission-level headline: prefer objective events; never last filename alone.
 */
export function projectMissionHeadline(
  events: Array<ActivityLabelInput & { sequence: number; nature: string }>,
): string {
  const objective = [...events]
    .reverse()
    .find(
      (e) =>
        /objective|investigation\.engaged/i.test(e.phase || "") ||
        detailString(e.detail, "objective"),
    );
  if (objective) {
    const o = detailString(objective.detail, "objective") || objective.summary;
    if (o && !looksTechnical(o) && !/^Prise en charge/i.test(o)) return o.slice(0, 160);
  }
  const last = events[events.length - 1];
  if (last) {
    const headline = projectActivityLabel(last).slice(0, 160);
    if (headline && !/Consultation Git —/i.test(headline)) return headline;
  }
  return "Activité Nora";
}
