function rowToProjection(
  row: typeof trajectoryQualificationOperations.$inferSelect,
  forecastSteps: InitialQualificationProjection["forecastSteps"],
  clarificationQuestion: string | null,
): InitialQualificationProjection {
  const status = row.status as QualificationStatus;
  const phase = row.phase as QualificationPhase;
  const composerLocked = isInitialQualificationComposerLocked({
    operationId: row.id,
    projectId: row.projectId,
    preparationId: row.preparationId,
    status,
    phase,
    version: row.version,
    uiStep: phaseToUiStep(phase),
    composerLocked: false,
    composerLockReason: "",
    trajectoryRevisionId: row.trajectoryRevisionId,
    assistantMessageId: row.assistantMessageId,
    forecastSteps,
    clarificationQuestion,
    errorCode: row.errorCode,
  });
  return {
    operationId: row.id,
    projectId: row.projectId,
    preparationId: row.preparationId,
    status,
    phase,
    version: row.version,
    uiStep: phaseToUiStep(phase),
    composerLocked,
    composerLockReason: initialQualificationComposerReason({
      operationId: row.id,
      projectId: row.projectId,
      preparationId: row.preparationId,
      status,
      phase,
      version: row.version,
      uiStep: phaseToUiStep(phase),
      composerLocked,
      composerLockReason: "",
      trajectoryRevisionId: row.trajectoryRevisionId,
      assistantMessageId: row.assistantMessageId,
      forecastSteps,
      clarificationQuestion,
      errorCode: row.errorCode,
    }),
    trajectoryRevisionId: row.trajectoryRevisionId,
    assistantMessageId: row.assistantMessageId,
    forecastSteps,
    clarificationQuestion,
    errorCode: row.errorCode,
  };
}

function parseResultJson(raw: unknown): {
  clarificationQuestion: string | null;
  forecastSteps: InitialQualificationProjection["forecastSteps"];
  assistantContent: string | null;
  orientation: string | null;
} {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") {
    return {
      clarificationQuestion: null,
      forecastSteps: null,
      assistantContent: null,
      orientation: null,
    };
  }
  const o = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const clarificationQuestion =
    typeof o.clarificationQuestion === "string" ? o.clarificationQuestion : null;
  const forecastSteps = parseForecastJson(o.forecastSteps);
  const assistantContent = typeof o.assistantContent === "string" ? o.assistantContent : null;
  const orientation = typeof o.orientation === "string" ? o.orientation : null;
  return { clarificationQuestion, forecastSteps, assistantContent, orientation };
}

/** P0-02 — stable assistant body for resume; never rebuild a divergent summary. */
function resumeAssistantContent(
  parsed: ReturnType<typeof parseResultJson>,
  projectName: string,
): string {
  if (parsed.assistantContent?.trim()) return parsed.assistantContent;
  if (parsed.clarificationQuestion?.trim()) return parsed.clarificationQuestion;
  if (parsed.forecastSteps?.length) {
    return buildAssistantContentFallback(
      {
        kind: "PROPOSE",
        steps: parsed.forecastSteps,
        orientation: parsed.orientation ?? "Trajectoire proposée",
        summary:
          parsed.orientation ??
          "Proposition de trajectoire initiale (restitution durable reprise).",
      },
      projectName,
    );
  }
  return buildAssistantContentFallback(
    {
      kind: "PROPOSE",
      steps: [],
      orientation: "Trajectoire proposée",
      summary: "Proposition de trajectoire initiale reprise après interruption.",
    },
    projectName,
  );
}

export async function getQualificationProjection(
  pilotId: string,
  projectId: string,
): Promise<InitialQualificationProjection | null> {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.projectId, projectId),
          eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.pilotId, pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) return null;
  const parsed = parseResultJson(row.resultJson);
  return rowToProjection(row, parsed.forecastSteps, parsed.clarificationQuestion);
}

export async function ensureInitialQualification(input: {
  projectId: string;
  preparationId: string;
  pilotId: string;
}): Promise<InitialQualificationProjection> {
  const existing = await getQualificationProjection(input.pilotId, input.projectId);
  if (existing) return existing;

  const prep = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(preparations)
      .where(
        and(eq(preparations.id, input.preparationId), eq(preparations.ownerPilotId, input.pilotId)),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!prep) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Préparation introuvable");

  const projection = parseProjectionJson(
    prep.projectionJson,
    prep.id,
    prep.creationRevision,
  );
  const fingerprint = qualificationInputFingerprint({
    preparationId: prep.id,
    projection,
    previewSummary: prep.previewSummary ?? "",
    creationRevision: prep.creationRevision,
  });

  const id = newId("iqop");
  const now = new Date();
  try {
    await db.insert(trajectoryQualificationOperations).values({
      id,
      projectId: input.projectId,
      preparationId: input.preparationId,
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      status: "PENDING",
      phase: "ENGAGED",
      version: 1,
      inputFingerprint: fingerprint,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    });
  } catch {
  }

  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
      .where(eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.projectId, input.projectId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) throw new StudioError("INTERNAL", "Qualification initiale non créée");
  return rowToProjection(row, null, null);
}

function initialQualificationGenerationId(
  operationId: string,
  version: number,
  role: "assistant" | "system",
): string {
  // E07-FIX-02 — cognitive vs Studio incident must not share generation identity.
  return role === "system"
    ? `sfia:iq:${operationId}:v${version}:system`
    : `sfia:iq:${operationId}:v${version}`;
}

function stableQualificationMessageId(
  operationId: string,
  version: number,
  role: "assistant" | "system",
): string {
  return role === "system"
    ? `msg_iq_${operationId}_v${version}_system`
    : `msg_iq_${operationId}_v${version}`;
}

function messageMatchesQualificationIntent(
  row: { role: string; content: string; conversationId: string },
  expected: { role: string; content: string; conversationId: string },
): boolean {
  return (
    row.role === expected.role &&
    row.content === expected.content &&
    row.conversationId === expected.conversationId
  );
}

/**
 * E07-FIX-01 — fence at write point: FOR UPDATE op + ownerToken CAS, then insert.
 * TOCTOU after check is closed inside the same transaction as the insert.
 */
async function appendQualificationThreadMessage(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  preparationId: string;
  operationId: string;
  ownerToken: string;
  version: number;
  content: string;
  /** E07-COR-08 — Studio incidents use system; Nora cognitive uses assistant. */
  role: "assistant" | "system";
}): Promise<string | null> {
  const conv = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(conversations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(conversations.preparationId, input.preparationId),
          eq(conversations.ownerPilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!conv) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Conversation introuvable");

  const generationId = initialQualificationGenerationId(
    input.operationId,
    input.version,
    input.role,
  );
  const stableId = stableQualificationMessageId(input.operationId, input.version, input.role);

  // E07-FIX-01 — CAS outside TX so afterOwnerCheckBeforeEffect can race (lease steal).
  const casOk = await updateOpIfOwner(input.operationId, input.ownerToken, {
    updatedAt: new Date(),
  });
  if (!casOk) return null;
  await initialQualificationFault.afterOwnerCheckBeforeEffect?.();

  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const locked = await tx.execute(
      sql`select id, owner_token from trajectory_qualification_operations where id = ${input.operationId} for update`,
    );
    const rows = (
      Array.isArray(locked)
        ? locked
        : ((locked as { rows?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }).rows ?? [])
    ) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    const op = rows[0];
    if (!op || String(op.owner_token ?? "") !== input.ownerToken) {
      return null;
    }

    const existingByGen = (
      await tx
        .select()
        .from(messages)
        .where(and(eq(messages.conversationId, conv.id), eq(messages.generationId, generationId)))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (existingByGen) {
      if (
        messageMatchesQualificationIntent(existingByGen, {
          role: input.role,
          content: input.content,
          conversationId: conv.id,
        })
      ) {
        return existingByGen.id;
      }
      throw new StudioError(
        "CONFLICT",
        "Message de qualification existant incompatible (rôle/contenu)",
      );
    }

    const existingById = (
      await tx.select().from(messages).where(eq(messages.id, stableId)).limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (existingById) {
      if (
        messageMatchesQualificationIntent(existingById, {
          role: input.role,
          content: input.content,
          conversationId: conv.id,
        })
      ) {
        return existingById.id;
      }
      throw new StudioError(
        "CONFLICT",
        "Identité de message de qualification déjà utilisée avec un autre contenu",
      );
    }

    const last = (
      await tx
        .select({ ordinal: messages.ordinal })
        .from(messages)
        .where(eq(messages.conversationId, conv.id))
        .orderBy(asc(messages.ordinal))
    ).at(-1);
    const ordinal = (last?.ordinal ?? 0) + 1;
    const now = new Date();

    await tx.insert(messages).values({
      id: stableId,
      conversationId: conv.id,
      role: input.role,
      content: input.content,
      status: "COMPLETE",
      ordinal,
      generationId,
      createdAt: now,
    });
    return stableId;
  });
}

async function currentPilotageRevision(projectId: string): Promise<number> {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select({ revision: projectPilotageState.revision })
      .from(projectPilotageState)
      .where(eq(projectPilotageState.projectId, projectId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  return row?.revision ?? 0;
}

async function publishProposedTrajectory(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  operationId: string;
  ownerToken: string;
  version: number;
  orientation: string;
  forecastSteps: ForecastBuildResult & { kind: "PROPOSE" };
}): Promise<string | null> {
  // P0-01 — last outer CAS; true fence is effectOwnerFence inside runBusinessCommand TX.
  const stillOwner = await updateOpIfOwner(input.operationId, input.ownerToken, {
    updatedAt: new Date(),
  });
  if (!stillOwner) return null;

  // Discriminant race window: after last successful CAS, before D5 mutate TX.
  await initialQualificationFault.afterOwnerCheckBeforeEffect?.();

  const clientCommandKey = `iq:${input.operationId}:v${input.version}:propose`;
  const expectedRevision = await currentPilotageRevision(input.projectId);
  const result = await executePilotageCommand(input.pilotId, input.projectId, {
    clientCommandKey,
    expectedRevision,
    operation: "PROPOSE_TRAJECTORY",
    sourceKind: "COGNITIVE_PROPOSAL",
    sourceRef: input.operationId,
    orientation: input.orientation,
    forecastJson: input.forecastSteps.steps,
    actInstanceId: clientCommandKey,
    effectOwnerFence: {
      operationId: input.operationId,
      ownerToken: input.ownerToken,
    },
  });
  if (result.status === "REJECTED") {
    if (result.reasonCode === "QUALIFICATION_OWNERSHIP_LOST") {
      return null;
    }
    throw new StudioError("INTERNAL", result.reason ?? "Proposition D5 refusée");
  }
  if (result.status === "CONFLICT") {
    throw new StudioError("INTERNAL", result.reason ?? "Proposition D5 en conflit");
  }
  // Post-effect fence: expired owner must not claim terminal over a newer claim.
  const stillOwnerAfter = await updateOpIfOwner(input.operationId, input.ownerToken, {
    updatedAt: new Date(),
  });
  if (!stillOwnerAfter) return null;

  const propose = result.effects.find((e) => e.effectKind === "PROPOSE");
  if (!propose?.targetRef) throw new StudioError("INTERNAL", "Trajectoire PROPOSED absente");
  return propose.targetRef;
}

async function updateOpIfOwner(
  opId: string,
  ownerToken: string,
  patch: Partial<typeof trajectoryQualificationOperations.$inferInsert>,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const updated = await db
    .update(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
    .set({ ...patch, updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.id, opId),
        eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.ownerToken, ownerToken),
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: trajectoryQualificationOperations.id });
  return updated.length > 0;
}

/** E07-COR-04 — fence before side effects (D5 propose / thread message). */
async function stillOwnsOperation(opId: string, ownerToken: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select({ id: trajectoryQualificationOperations.id })
      .from(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.id, opId),
          eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.ownerToken, ownerToken),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  return Boolean(row);
}

/**
 * Deterministic fallback narrative (tutoiement). Used when Nora cognitive
 * generation is unavailable — never presented as a substitute for D5 structure.
 */
function buildAssistantContentFallback(
  built: ForecastBuildResult,
  projectName: string,
): string {
  if (built.kind === "CLARIFICATION") {
    return built.question;
  }
  const first = built.steps[0];
  const follow = built.steps.slice(1);
  const lines = [
    `**${projectName}** — voici ma première recommandation de trajectoire (non retenue).`,
    "",
    built.summary.trim(),
    "",
  ];
  if (first) {
    lines.push(
      `Je te recommande de commencer par **${first.cycleType.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase()}** : ${first.rationale}`,
    );
    lines.push("");
  }
  if (follow.length > 0) {
    lines.push("Ensuite, selon ce que ce premier cycle aura clarifié :");
    for (const s of follow) {
      lines.push(
        `- **${s.cycleType.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase()}** — ${s.rationale}`,
      );
    }
    lines.push("");
  }
  if (built.orientation?.trim()) {
    lines.push(`Orientation proposée : ${built.orientation.trim()}`);
    lines.push("");
  }
  lines.push(
    "Tu peux retenir cette direction, la contester ou demander un autre premier cycle — l’ouverture d’un cycle reste une décision distincte, à toi.",
  );
  return lines.join("\n");
}

/**
 * ML5 — Nora proposes structured forecast steps; D5 validates catalog membership.
 * Replaces lexical inferPreferredFirstCycle. No regex / dictionary cycle choice.
 */
async function buildCognitiveForecast(input: {
  projection: ReturnType<typeof parseProjectionJson> | null;
  previewSummary: string;
  projectName: string;
}): Promise<{
  built: ForecastBuildResult;
  structureSource: "NORA_COGNITIVE" | "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK";
}> {
  const sufficiency = forecastInputSufficiency({
    projection: input.projection,
    previewSummary: input.previewSummary,
  });
  if (!sufficiency.ok) {
    return { built: sufficiency.result, structureSource: "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK" };
  }
  const catalogLines = CYCLE_TYPES.map(
    (t) => `- ${t} (${CYCLE_LABELS[t]})`,
  ).join("\n");
  try {
    const { generateNoraReply } = await import("@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter");
    const { buildCognitivePolicy } = await import("@/domains/conversation/cognitive-policy");
    const policy = buildCognitivePolicy(
      `Qualification trajectoire ${input.projectName}`,
      undefined,
      { profileHint: "analyse", effortHint: "medium" },
    );
    const slimPolicy = {
      ...policy,
      toolAllowlist: [] as typeof policy.toolAllowlist,
      budgets: {
        ...policy.budgets,
        maxProviderCalls: Math.min(policy.budgets.maxProviderCalls, 2),
        maxD4ToolCalls: 0,
        maxGitToolCalls: 0,
        maxD4CharsReturned: 0,
      },
    };
    const reply = await generateNoraReply({
      userText: [
        `Le projet « ${input.projectName} » vient d'être créé.`,
        "Propose une première trajectoire de cycles SFIA proportionnée.",
        "Choisis 1 à 3 types de cycles dans le catalogue canonique ci-dessous.",
        "Émets des intents d5.pilotage_command mode=PREPARE operation=PROPOSE_TRAJECTORY avec parameters.cycleType pour chaque étape (ordre = ordre des intents).",
        "N'ouvre aucun cycle. Ne demande pas au Pilote de choisir un type de cycle si les acquis SAS suffisent.",
        "Clarifie seulement si l'intention ou le résultat utile manquent vraiment.",
      ].join("\n"),
      contextSnippets: [
        `Intention: ${input.projection?.intention?.value || "(non précisée)"}`,
        `Résultat attendu: ${input.projection?.desiredOutcome?.value || "(non précisé)"}`,
        `Périmètre: ${input.projection?.initialScope?.value || "(non précisé)"}`,
        (input.projection?.openQuestions ?? [])
          .map((q) => q.value?.trim())
          .filter(Boolean)
          .length
          ? `Points ouverts: ${(input.projection?.openQuestions ?? [])
              .map((q) => q.value?.trim())
              .filter(Boolean)
              .slice(0, 8)
              .join(" · ")}`
          : "Points ouverts: (aucun structuré)",
        input.previewSummary
          ? `Synthèse SAS: ${input.previewSummary.slice(0, 1200)}`
          : "",
        `Catalogue cycles SFIA (uniquement ces types):\n${catalogLines}`,
      ].filter(Boolean),
      policyOverride: slimPolicy,
    });
    const fromIntents = forecastStepsFromQualificationIntents(
      reply.qualification?.intents ?? [],
    );
    let steps: ForecastStep[] = fromIntents;
    if (!steps.length && reply.qualification) {
      // Optional structured array if Nora embeds forecastSteps in reply (future-safe).
      const raw = (reply.qualification as { forecastSteps?: unknown }).forecastSteps;
      const parsed = parseForecastJson(raw);
      if (parsed?.length) steps = parsed;
    }
    if (steps.length) {
      const assembled = assembleForecastFromSteps(steps);
      const validated = validateStructuredForecast(assembled);
      if (validated.ok && assembled.kind === "PROPOSE") {
        return { built: assembled, structureSource: "NORA_COGNITIVE" };
      }
    }
    // Nora returned clarification-shaped reply with insufficient structure.
    if (
      reply.qualification?.status === "NEEDS_CLARIFICATION" &&
      (reply.qualification.clarifications?.length ?? 0) > 0
    ) {
      return {
        built: {
          kind: "CLARIFICATION",
          question:
            reply.qualification.clarifications![0] ||
            (reply.content || "").trim() ||
            "Précise le premier résultat utile attendu.",
          missing: ["clarification Nora"],
        },
        structureSource: "NORA_COGNITIVE",
      };
    }
  } catch {
    /* fallback below */
  }
  // Honest fallback when Nora structure unavailable but SAS acquis suffice:
  // proportional first cycle CONCEPTION_FONCTIONNELLE — methodological default,
  // NOT lexical matching of the Pilote text (AssetTrack-class apps).
  const fallbackSteps: ForecastStep[] = [
    {
      order: 1,
      cycleType: "CONCEPTION_FONCTIONNELLE",
      rationale:
        "Premier cycle proportionné : préciser le parcours utile et les règles métier avant réalisation, à partir de l'intention déjà qualifiée.",
      certainty: "QUALIFIED",
    },
    {
      order: 2,
      cycleType: "DELIVERY",
      rationale: "Suite envisagée si la conception confirme le périmètre.",
      certainty: "ENVISIONED",
    },
  ];
  const assembled = assembleForecastFromSteps(fallbackSteps);
  return { built: assembled, structureSource: "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK" };
}

/**
 * RB-11/13 — first trajectory narrative via D3 Nora (cognitive), D5 remains owner
 * of structured forecast / publishProposedTrajectory. Failure falls back honestly.
 */
async function buildCognitiveTrajectoryNarrative(input: {
  built: ForecastBuildResult;
  projectName: string;
  intention?: string;
  desiredOutcome?: string;
  initialScope?: string;
  openQuestions?: string[];
  previewSummary?: string;
}): Promise<{ content: string; source: "NORA_COGNITIVE" | "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK" }> {
  if (input.built.kind === "CLARIFICATION") {
    return { content: input.built.question, source: "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK" };
  }
  const fallback = buildAssistantContentFallback(input.built, input.projectName);
  try {
    const { generateNoraReply } = await import("@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter");
    const { buildCognitivePolicy } = await import("@/domains/conversation/cognitive-policy");
    const stepLines = input.built.steps
      .map(
        (s) =>
          `${s.order}. ${s.cycleType} (${s.certainty}) — ${s.rationale}`,
      )
      .join("\n");
    const policy = buildCognitivePolicy(
      `Trajectoire initiale ${input.projectName}`,
      undefined,
      { profileHint: "simple", effortHint: "low" },
    );
    // No tools — narrative only; D5 already owns the structured steps.
    const slimPolicy = {
      ...policy,
      toolAllowlist: [] as typeof policy.toolAllowlist,
      budgets: {
        ...policy.budgets,
        maxProviderCalls: Math.min(policy.budgets.maxProviderCalls, 2),
        maxD4ToolCalls: 0,
        maxGitToolCalls: 0,
        maxD4CharsReturned: 0,
      },
    };
    const reply = await generateNoraReply({
      userText: [
        `Le projet « ${input.projectName} » vient d’être créé.`,
        "Rédige la première recommandation de trajectoire pour le Pilote (tutoiement, ton professionnel et naturel).",
        "Explique le premier cycle recommandé, pourquoi il est pertinent, ce qu’il permettra d’obtenir, les étapes suivantes utiles et les réserves significatives.",
        "N’ouvre aucun cycle. N’invente pas de décision retenue. Ne propose pas d’effet D4/D7.",
        "Appuie-toi sur la structure D5 ci-dessous sans la contredire.",
      ].join("\n"),
      contextSnippets: [
        `Intention: ${input.intention || "(non précisée)"}`,
        `Résultat attendu: ${input.desiredOutcome || "(non précisé)"}`,
        `Périmètre: ${input.initialScope || "(non précisé)"}`,
        input.openQuestions?.length
          ? `Points ouverts: ${input.openQuestions.join(" · ")}`
          : "Points ouverts: (aucun structuré)",
        input.previewSummary ? `Synthèse SAS: ${input.previewSummary.slice(0, 1200)}` : "",
        `Orientation D5: ${input.built.orientation}`,
        `Étapes D5 (autorité structure):\n${stepLines}`,
        `Résumé D5: ${input.built.summary}`,
      ].filter(Boolean),
      policyOverride: slimPolicy,
    });
    const text = (reply.content || reply.qualification?.replyDraft || "").trim();
    if (text.length >= 80 && reply.status !== "FAILED") {
      return { content: text, source: "NORA_COGNITIVE" };
    }
  } catch {
    /* fallback below */
  }
  return { content: fallback, source: "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK" };
}

function studioFailedMessage(): string {
  return [
    "[Studio] La qualification initiale de trajectoire n'a pas abouti techniquement.",
    "Le projet reste accessible. Tu peux continuer la conversation pour préciser ton intention ; la trajectoire pourra être qualifiée ultérieurement.",
  ].join("\n");
}

const TERMINAL = new Set<QualificationStatus>(["PROPOSED", "CLARIFICATION", "FAILED"]);

export async function processInitialQualification(
  projectId: string,
  opts?: { force?: boolean; pilotId?: string },
): Promise<InitialQualificationProjection | null> {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
      .where(eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.projectId, projectId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) return null;
  if (opts?.pilotId && row.pilotId !== opts.pilotId) return null;

  if (TERMINAL.has(row.status as QualificationStatus) && !opts?.force) {
    const parsed = parseResultJson(row.resultJson);
    return rowToProjection(row, parsed.forecastSteps, parsed.clarificationQuestion);
  }

  /** DEV visual capture only — freeze PENDING/RUNNING so 09.10 / 05.17 remain observable. */
  if (
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE === "DEV" &&
    process.env.STUDIO_DEV_HOLD_INITIAL_QUALIFICATION === "1" &&
    !opts?.force
  ) {
    const parsed = parseResultJson(row.resultJson);
    return rowToProjection(row, parsed.forecastSteps, parsed.clarificationQuestion);
  }

  const ownerToken = newId("iqtk");
  const now = new Date();

  const claimed = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const execResult = await tx.execute(
      sql`select * from trajectory_qualification_operations where project_id = ${projectId} for update`,
    );
    const locked = (
      Array.isArray(execResult)
        ? execResult
        : ((execResult as { rows?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }).rows ?? [])
    ) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    const cur = locked[0];
    if (!cur) return null;
    const status = String(cur.status) as QualificationStatus;
    if (TERMINAL.has(status) && !opts?.force) return { kind: "terminal" as const, id: String(cur.id) };

    if (status === "RUNNING" && cur.owner_token && cur.claimed_at) {
      const claimedAt = new Date(String(cur.claimed_at)).getTime();
      if (Date.now() - claimedAt < CLAIM_LEASE_MS) {
        return { kind: "busy" as const, id: String(cur.id) };
      }
      // Lease expired — mark UNKNOWN then reclaim (E07-COR-05).
      await tx
        .update(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
        .set({ status: "UNKNOWN", updatedAt: now })
        .where(eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.id, String(cur.id)));
    }

    const priorTrajectoryId =
      cur.trajectory_revision_id != null ? String(cur.trajectory_revision_id) : null;
    const priorResult = cur.result_json ?? null;

    await tx
      .update(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
      .set({
        status: "RUNNING",
        phase: priorTrajectoryId ? "PUBLISHING" : "ANALYZING",
        ownerToken,
        claimedAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .where(eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.id, String(cur.id)));

    return {
      kind: "claimed" as const,
      id: String(cur.id),
      pilotId: String(cur.pilot_id),
      preparationId: String(cur.preparation_id),
      version: Number(cur.version),
      priorTrajectoryId,
      priorResult,
    };
  });

  if (!claimed || claimed.kind === "busy") {
    return getQualificationProjection(row.pilotId, projectId);
  }
  if (claimed.kind === "terminal") {
    return getQualificationProjection(row.pilotId, projectId);
  }

  try {
    const prep = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(preparations)
        .where(eq(preparations.id, claimed.preparationId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    const projection = prep
      ? parseProjectionJson(prep.projectionJson, prep.id, prep.creationRevision)
      : null;
    const projectRow = (
      await db.select({ name: projects.name }).from(projects).where(eq(projects.id, projectId)).limit(1)
    )[0];
    const name = projectRow?.name ?? "Projet";

    // Resume path: D5 already published, message/terminal missing (P0-02 / E07-COR-03).
    if (claimed.priorTrajectoryId) {
      const parsedPrior = parseResultJson(claimed.priorResult);
      const stableContent = resumeAssistantContent(parsedPrior, name);
      const assistantMessageId = await appendQualificationThreadMessage({
        pilotId: claimed.pilotId,
        preparationId: claimed.preparationId,
        operationId: claimed.id,
        ownerToken,
        version: claimed.version,
        content: stableContent,
        role: "assistant",
      });
      if (!assistantMessageId) {
        return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
      }
      const priorJson =
        claimed.priorResult && typeof claimed.priorResult === "object"
          ? ({ ...(claimed.priorResult as Record<string, unknown>) } as Record<string, unknown>)
          : ({
              kind: "PROPOSED",
              forecastSteps: parsedPrior.forecastSteps,
            } as Record<string, unknown>);
      if (!priorJson.assistantContent) priorJson.assistantContent = stableContent;
      const ok = await updateOpIfOwner(claimed.id, ownerToken, {
        status: "PROPOSED",
        phase: "TERMINAL",
        trajectoryRevisionId: claimed.priorTrajectoryId,
        assistantMessageId,
        resultJson: priorJson,
        ownerToken: null,
        errorCode: null,
      });
      if (!ok) {
        await updateOpIfOwner(claimed.id, ownerToken, {
          status: "UNKNOWN",
          phase: "PUBLISHING",
        });
      }
      return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
    }

    await initialQualificationFault.beforePublish?.();

    const phaseOk = await updateOpIfOwner(claimed.id, ownerToken, { phase: "PUBLISHING" });
    if (!phaseOk) {
      return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
    }

    // FIX-04 — refuse stale publish when durable input fingerprint no longer matches.
    if (prep) {
      const currentFp = qualificationInputFingerprint({
        preparationId: prep.id,
        projection,
        previewSummary: prep.previewSummary ?? "",
        creationRevision: prep.creationRevision,
      });
      const opRow = (
        await db
          .select({ inputFingerprint: trajectoryQualificationOperations.inputFingerprint })
          .from(trajectoryQualificationOperations)
          .where(eq(trajectoryQualificationOperations.id, claimed.id))
          .limit(1)
      )[0];
      if (opRow && opRow.inputFingerprint && opRow.inputFingerprint !== currentFp) {
        const staleContent =
          "Le contexte de préparation a évolué depuis l'engagement de la qualification. Une nouvelle analyse est nécessaire avant toute proposition de trajectoire.";
        const mid = await appendQualificationThreadMessage({
          pilotId: claimed.pilotId,
          preparationId: claimed.preparationId,
          operationId: claimed.id,
          ownerToken,
          version: claimed.version,
          content: staleContent,
          role: "assistant",
        });
        if (!mid) return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
        await updateOpIfOwner(claimed.id, ownerToken, {
          status: "CLARIFICATION",
          phase: "TERMINAL",
          assistantMessageId: mid,
          resultJson: {
            kind: "CLARIFICATION",
            clarificationQuestion: staleContent,
            missing: ["fingerprint"],
            assistantContent: staleContent,
            staleFingerprint: true,
          },
          ownerToken: null,
          errorCode: "STALE_INPUT_FINGERPRINT",
        });
        return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
      }
    }

    const cognitive = await buildCognitiveForecast({
      projection,
      previewSummary: prep?.previewSummary ?? "",
      projectName: name,
    });
    const validated = validateStructuredForecast(cognitive.built);
    const built: ForecastBuildResult = validated.ok
      ? cognitive.built
      : {
          kind: "CLARIFICATION",
          question:
            "Je n'ai pas pu qualifier une trajectoire structurée fiable à partir des éléments disponibles. Précise l'intention et le premier résultat utile attendu.",
          missing: ["sortie structurée", validated.reason],
        };

    let trajectoryRevisionId: string | null = null;
    let terminalStatus: QualificationStatus;
    let resultJson: Record<string, unknown>;
    const narrative = await buildCognitiveTrajectoryNarrative({
      built,
      projectName: name,
      intention: projection?.intention?.value,
      desiredOutcome: projection?.desiredOutcome?.value,
      initialScope: projection?.initialScope?.value,
      openQuestions: (projection?.openQuestions ?? [])
        .map((q) => q.value?.trim() || "")
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, 8),
      previewSummary: prep?.previewSummary ?? "",
    });
    const assistantContent = narrative.content;

    if (built.kind === "CLARIFICATION") {
      terminalStatus = "CLARIFICATION";
      resultJson = {
        kind: "CLARIFICATION",
        clarificationQuestion: built.question,
        missing: built.missing,
        assistantContent,
        narrativeSource: narrative.source,
        structureSource: cognitive.structureSource,
      };
    } else {
      trajectoryRevisionId = await publishProposedTrajectory({
        pilotId: claimed.pilotId,
        projectId,
        operationId: claimed.id,
        ownerToken,
        version: claimed.version,
        orientation: built.orientation,
        forecastSteps: built,
      });
      if (!trajectoryRevisionId) {
        return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
      }
      terminalStatus = "PROPOSED";
      resultJson = {
        kind: "PROPOSED",
        forecastSteps: built.steps,
        orientation: built.orientation,
        assistantContent,
        narrativeSource: narrative.source,
        structureSource: cognitive.structureSource,
      };
      // Persist D5 pointer + stable content before message so crash can resume (P0-02).
      const mid = await updateOpIfOwner(claimed.id, ownerToken, {
        trajectoryRevisionId,
        resultJson,
        phase: "PUBLISHING",
      });
      if (!mid) {
        return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
      }
    }

    const assistantMessageId = await appendQualificationThreadMessage({
      pilotId: claimed.pilotId,
      preparationId: claimed.preparationId,
      operationId: claimed.id,
      ownerToken,
      version: claimed.version,
      content: assistantContent,
      role: "assistant",
    });
    if (!assistantMessageId) {
      return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
    }

    if (built.kind === "PROPOSE" && !trajectoryRevisionId) {
      throw new StudioError("INTERNAL", "Publication incomplète");
    }

    const terminalOk = await updateOpIfOwner(claimed.id, ownerToken, {
      status: terminalStatus,
      phase: "TERMINAL",
      trajectoryRevisionId,
      assistantMessageId,
      resultJson,
      ownerToken: null,
      errorCode: null,
    });
    if (!terminalOk) {
      return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
    }

    return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof OwnershipLostError) {
      return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
    }
    const errorCode = e instanceof StudioError ? e.code : "QUALIFICATION_FAILED";
    const systemMessageId = await appendQualificationThreadMessage({
      pilotId: claimed.pilotId,
      preparationId: claimed.preparationId,
      operationId: claimed.id,
      ownerToken,
      version: claimed.version,
      content: studioFailedMessage(),
      role: "system",
    }).catch(() => null);

    if (!systemMessageId) {
      return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
    }

    const failedOk = await updateOpIfOwner(claimed.id, ownerToken, {
      status: "FAILED",
      phase: "TERMINAL",
      assistantMessageId: systemMessageId,
      errorCode,
      ownerToken: null,
      resultJson: { kind: "FAILED", errorCode },
    });
    if (!failedOk) {
      return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
    }

    return getQualificationProjection(claimed.pilotId, projectId);
  }
}

export function kickInitialQualificationProcessing(projectId: string, pilotId: string): void {
  void processInitialQualification(projectId, { pilotId }).catch(() => undefined);
}

/** E07-COR-01 — ensure durable op then kick; retry once on ensure failure. */
export async function ensureAndKickInitialQualification(input: {
  projectId: string;
  preparationId: string;
  pilotId: string;
}): Promise<{
  projection: InitialQualificationProjection | null;
  ensureStatus: "OK" | "FAILED_RETRYABLE";
}> {
  try {
    const projection = await ensureInitialQualification(input);
    kickInitialQualificationProcessing(input.projectId, input.pilotId);
    return { projection, ensureStatus: "OK" };
  } catch {
    try {
      const projection = await ensureInitialQualification(input);
      kickInitialQualificationProcessing(input.projectId, input.pilotId);
      return { projection, ensureStatus: "OK" };
    } catch {
      return { projection: null, ensureStatus: "FAILED_RETRYABLE" };
    }
  }
}

/**
 * E07-COR-01/02/05 — explicit reconcile (POST), never from GET.
 * Creates missing op when project+prep linked; processes PENDING/RUNNING/UNKNOWN.
 */
export async function reconcileInitialQualification(
  projectId: string,
  pilotId: string,
): Promise<InitialQualificationProjection | null> {
  const project = (
    await db
      .select({ id: projects.id })
      .from(projects)
      .where(and(eq(projects.id, projectId), eq(projects.ownerPilotId, pilotId)))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!project) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Projet introuvable");

  let projection = await getQualificationProjection(pilotId, projectId);
  if (!projection) {
    const link = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(preparationProjectLinks)
        .where(eq(preparationProjectLinks.projectId, projectId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    // P0-04 — never silently create qualification for legacy projects.
    if (!link || !link.initialQualificationExpected) return null;
    projection = await ensureInitialQualification({
      projectId,
      preparationId: link.preparationId,
      pilotId,
    });
  }

  if (
    projection.status === "PENDING" ||
    projection.status === "RUNNING" ||
    projection.status === "UNKNOWN"
  ) {
    return processInitialQualification(projectId, { pilotId });
  }
  return projection;
}

/** E07-FIX-05 — synthetic gate when prep↔project linked but op not yet persisted. */
export function pendingEnsureGateProjection(
  projectId: string,
  preparationId: string,
): InitialQualificationProjection {
  return {
    operationId: "",
    projectId,
    preparationId,
    status: "PENDING",
    phase: "ENGAGED",
    version: 0,
    uiStep: 1,
    composerLocked: true,
    composerLockReason:
      "Le projet est créé — la qualification initiale de trajectoire est en cours d'engagement.",
    trajectoryRevisionId: null,
    assistantMessageId: null,
    forecastSteps: null,
    clarificationQuestion: null,
    errorCode: null,
  };
}

export async function getQualificationProjectionForClient(
  pilotId: string,
  projectId: string,
): Promise<InitialQualificationProjection | null> {
  const q = await getQualificationProjection(pilotId, projectId);
  if (q) return q;
  const link = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(preparationProjectLinks)
      .where(eq(preparationProjectLinks.projectId, projectId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!link) return null;
  // P0-04 — legacy / pre-capability projects: no synthetic PENDING lock, no silent ensure.
  if (!link.initialQualificationExpected) return null;
  // New create: SAS link expects qualification but op not yet durable — keep Travail locked.
  return pendingEnsureGateProjection(projectId, link.preparationId);
}

export async function assertPilotTurnNotBlockedByQualification(
  pilotId: string,
  projectId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const q = await getQualificationProjectionForClient(pilotId, projectId);
  if (q && (q.status === "PENDING" || q.status === "RUNNING" || q.status === "UNKNOWN")) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "QUALIFICATION_IN_PROGRESS",
      "Qualification initiale de trajectoire en cours — envoyez un message après la proposition ou la clarification.",
      { httpStatus: 409 },
    );
  }
}

export { blocksPilotTurnAdmission, isInitialQualificationComposerLocked } from "@/domains/pilotage/qualification-lock";

function projection(partial: Partial<PreparationProjection>): PreparationProjection {
  return {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    preparationId: "prep_1",
    revision: 1,
    updatedFromTurnKey: null,
    observedAt: null,
    name: null,
    intention: null,

  });

      projection: projection({

/**
 * ML4C TEMP (DET) — O-02 cognitive confrontation is Nora-led; these tests guard
 * server-side restitution / projection rules without inventing D4 or D6 from EXPLAIN,
 * negation-shaped drafts, or retired lexical routers.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { qualifyDocumentAct, explicitDocumentIntent } from "@/domains/conversation/document-act";
import {
  deriveThreadTurnKind,
  effectIntents,
  extractKnowledgeProposals,
  extractPilotageBinding,
  matchPilotageIntentInQualification,
  projectStudioEffects,
  SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  validateNoraTurnQualification,
  type NoraTurnQualification,
} from "@/domains/conversation/semantic-qualification";
import { proposalFromStructured } from "@/domains/conversation/document-command";
import { asNoraQualification } from "../helpers/semantic-fixture-envelopes";

function qualified(partial: Partial<NoraTurnQualification> & Pick<NoraTurnQualification, "intents">): NoraTurnQualification {
  return asNoraQualification({
    status: "QUALIFIED",
    goal: "test",
    clarifications: [],
    replyDraft: "Réponse courte.",
    ...partial,
  });
}

describe("ML4C TEMP — restitution fail-closed (DET)", () => {
  it("TEMP-01: qualifyDocumentAct / explicitDocumentIntent stay lexical-retired", () => {
    for (const utterance of [
      "Crée un document de recette.",
      "Ne crée pas de document, explique seulement.",
      "Et si on rédigeait une synthèse ?",
    ]) {
      expect(qualifyDocumentAct(utterance)).toEqual({
        kind: "NONE",
        reason: "SEMANTIC_ROUTER_REQUIRED",
      });
      expect(explicitDocumentIntent(utterance)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("TEMP-02: EXPLAIN d4.create_document does not project D4 CREATE", () => {
    const q = qualified({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i-explain-doc",
          capabilityId: "d4.create_document",
          mode: "EXPLAIN",
          summary: "explain drafting",
          parameters: {},
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(effectIntents(q)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(projectStudioEffects(q).documentAct).toEqual({ kind: "NONE" });
    expect(deriveThreadTurnKind(q)).toBe("DIALOGUE_INDEPENDANT");
  });

  it("TEMP-03: EXPLAIN d6.human_decision never binds pilotage / HumanDecision", () => {
    const q = qualified({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i-explain-d6",
          capabilityId: "d6.human_decision",
          mode: "EXPLAIN",
          summary: "reflect on prior decision",
          parameters: {
            pilotageOperation: "RECORD_DECISION",
            decisionId: "dec-prior",
          },
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: ["prior-turn-summary-only"],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(extractPilotageBinding(q)).toBeNull();
    const match = matchPilotageIntentInQualification(q, { operation: "RECORD_DECISION" });
    expect("reject" in match && match.reject).toBe(true);
    expect(projectStudioEffects(q).simpleDialogue).toBe(true);
  });

  it("TEMP-04: REQUEST_EFFECT d4.create_document still projects CREATE when not follow-on gated", () => {
    const q = qualified({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i-create",
          capabilityId: "d4.create_document",
          mode: "REQUEST_EFFECT",
          summary: "create",
          parameters: {},
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(projectStudioEffects(q).documentAct).toEqual({
      kind: "CREATE",
      mode: "REQUEST_EFFECT",
      inspectionRequired: false,
      intentId: "i-create",
    });
    expect(deriveThreadTurnKind(q)).toBe("INTENTION_EFFET");
  });

  it("ML5: PREPARE create projects documentAct without widening effectIntents", () => {
    const q = qualified({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i-prep-note",
          capabilityId: "d4.create_document",
          mode: "PREPARE",
          summary: "Préparer une note",
          parameters: {},
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
        {
          id: "i-pub",
          capabilityId: "d7.prepare_publication",
          mode: "PREPARE",
          summary: "should not project as publish effect",
          parameters: {},
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    const proj = projectStudioEffects(q);
    expect(proj.documentAct).toEqual({
      kind: "CREATE",
      mode: "PREPARE",
      inspectionRequired: false,
      intentId: "i-prep-note",
    });
    expect(proj.publication.wantsPublish).toBe(false);
    expect(effectIntents(q)).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("TEMP-05: hypothetical d4.record_knowledge EXPLAIN does not capitalise", () => {
    const q = qualified({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i-hyp",
          capabilityId: "d4.record_knowledge",
          mode: "EXPLAIN",
          summary: "hypothesis only",
          parameters: {
            knowledgeKind: "ACQUIS",
            knowledgeStatement: "L’architecture pourrait être event-driven.",
            epistemic: "hypothesized",
          },
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(extractKnowledgeProposals(q)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(projectStudioEffects(q).documentAct).toEqual({ kind: "NONE" });
  });

  it("TEMP-06: documentProposal >12k via proposalFromStructured stays admissible envelope", () => {
    const longDoc = `# Synthèse\n\n${"ligne de contenu détaillée.\n".repeat(850)}`;
    expect(longDoc.length).toBeGreaterThan(12_000);
    expect(longDoc.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100_000);
    const p = proposalFromStructured({ title: "Synthèse", contentMarkdown: longDoc });
    expect(p).not.toBeNull();
    expect(p!.contentMarkdown.length).toBeGreaterThan(12_000);
  });

  it("TEMP-07: conversation history in sourceEvidence alone does not add REQUEST_EFFECT", () => {
    const q = qualified({
      goal: "reprendre le fil",
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i-dialogue",

        },
      ],
    });
    expect(effectIntents(q)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(deriveThreadTurnKind(q)).toBe("DIALOGUE_INDEPENDANT");
    expect(projectStudioEffects(q).simpleDialogue).toBe(true);
  });

  it("TEMP-09: documentSource schema accepts PRIOR_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE", () => {
    const v = validateNoraTurnQualification({
      schemaVersion: SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      status: "QUALIFIED",

    });
    expect(v.ok).toBe(true);

  it("TEMP-10: documentSource + documentProposal → DOCUMENT_SOURCE_AND_PROPOSAL_CONFLICT", () => {
    const v = validateNoraTurnQualification({
      schemaVersion: SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      status: "QUALIFIED",
      goal: "conflit",
      intents: [],
      clarifications: [],
      replyDraft: "ok",
      documentSource: { kind: "PRIOR_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE", assistantMessageId: "msg-hist-1" },
      documentProposal: { title: "T", contentMarkdown: "# T\n\nx\n" },
    });
    expect(v.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!v.ok) expect(v.reason).toBe("DOCUMENT_SOURCE_AND_PROPOSAL_CONFLICT");
  });

  it("TEMP-08: D2 follow-on chains defer immediate documentAct to mission pending", () => {
    const q = qualified({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i-d2",
          capabilityId: "d2.create_project",

          summary: "follow-on doc",
          parameters: {},
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: ["i-d2"],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    const proj = projectStudioEffects(q);
    expect(proj.wantsFollowOnDocument).toBe(true);
    expect(proj.documentAct).toEqual({ kind: "NONE" });
  });
});

+
+## Mandat
+
+Correctif intégré Cycle 8 INC Critical — GO Morris 25/11 :

+suppression des déclencheurs lexicaux de conduite cognitive ;
+guidance SFIA menée par Nora ; activité LIVE métier hiérarchisée et dépliable.
+
+Principe : **Nora orchestre · Studio fournit les capacités · le Pilote décide.**
+
+## Contrat d'interaction (réalisé)
+
+| Étape | Avant (cause AssetTrack) | Après |
+|---|---|---|
+| Qualification | Modes PREPARE / REQUEST_EFFECT / EXPLORE | Inchangés sémantiquement |
+| Matérialisation D4 | `effectIntents` = REQUEST_EFFECT seul → PREPARE documentaire perdu (`documentAct NONE` / CONFLICT) | `documentaryMaterializeIntents` = PREPARE \| REQUEST_EFFECT **uniquement** pour `d4.create_document` / `d4.revise_document` |
+| Effets protégés | — | D6 / D7 / D9 restent hors élargissement (toujours `effectIntents`) |
+| Restitution | Annonce possible sans objet | Statuts distincts : analyse / proposition / candidat / AVAILABLE / refus / échec |
+| Guidance D5 | `inferPreferredFirstCycle` lexical → null → CLARIFICATION | `buildCognitiveForecast` (Nora) → D5 valide le catalogue ; `buildInitialForecast` tombstone CLARIFICATION sans matching |
+| Activité | Journal technique / titre = dernier fichier | Niveau 1 objectif · Niveau 2 groupes adaptatifs · Niveau 3 détails dépliables |
+
+## Inventaire KEEP / SIMPLIFY / REMOVE
+
+| Mécanisme | Verdict | Justification |
+|---|---|---|
+| Conducteur D3 adaptatif / segmentation / checkpoints | KEEP | Acquis cognitif ; non concurrent |
+| `effectIntents` (REQUEST_EFFECT) | KEEP | Autorité effets protégés |
+| `documentaryMaterializeIntents` | KEEP (nouveau périmètre) | Répare PREPARE documentaire sans élargir D6/D7/D9 |
+| Contenu consolidé DOCUMENT (Option B) | KEEP / SIMPLIFY | Une représentation canonique soumise à D4 |
+| `pendingDocumentCandidate` + conserve explicite | KEEP | Inspection puis conservation ; identité `candidateId` + SHA |
+| Fence `sfia-document` LEGACY | SIMPLIFY | Lecture historique seulement ; plus d'autorité concurrente du contenu courant |
+| `PRIOR_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE` comme source canonique | REMOVE (chemin courant) | Acquis possibles, pas second document canonique |
+| Titres `document-part-N` | REMOVE (défaut métier) | Bloqués comme titre documentaire |
+| `inferPreferredFirstCycle` / matching lexical cycles | REMOVE | Tombstone `buildInitialForecast` ; décision via Nora |
+| Dictionnaire mots-clés prêts/matériel/inventaire | REMOVE | Non réintroduit |
+| Production adaptative documents longs | KEEP | Pas d'imposition sortie unique fournisseur |
+| Journal d'activité unique + producers Git/D4/objective | KEEP / SIMPLIFY | Généralisé ; regroupement métier |
+| Contrôles CAS / fencing / idempotence / HumanDecision | KEEP | Intégrité |

+

+/**
+ * ML5 GO Morris — short LIVE natural-language path (DEV :3100 only).
+ * Forbidden: « Crée le document D4 », « REQUEST_EFFECT », pre-injected qualification.
+ * Asserts: create on first natural ask · revise pending · note on first pass.
+ */
+import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
+import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
+import { execSync } from "node:child_process";
+
+const BASE = process.env.SFIA_LIVE_BASE || "http://127.0.0.1:3100";
+const OUT = process.env.SFIA_LIVE_OUT || "/tmp/sfia-ml5-capability-interactions-proofs";
+mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
+const jar = { cookie: "" };
+
+async function api(path, { method = "GET", body, timeoutMs = 900_000 } = {}) {
+  const ctrl = new AbortController();
+  const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), timeoutMs);
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
+      method,
+      headers: {
+        ...(body ? { "content-type": "application/json" } : {}),
+        ...(jar.cookie ? { cookie: jar.cookie } : {}),
+      },
+      body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
+      signal: ctrl.signal,
+    });
+    const set = res.headers.getSetCookie?.() || [];
+    for (const c of set) {
+      const part = c.split(";")[0];
+      jar.cookie = jar.cookie ? `${jar.cookie}; ${part}` : part;
+    }
+    const text = await res.text();
+    let json = null;
+    try {
+      json = JSON.parse(text);
+    } catch {
+      json = { _raw: text.slice(0, 2000) };
+    }
+    return { status: res.status, json };
+  } finally {
+    clearTimeout(t);
+  }
+}
+
+function save(name, data) {
+  writeFileSync(`${OUT}/${name}.json`, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
+}
+
+function pg(sql) {
+  const oneLine = sql.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
+  return execSync(
+    `docker exec sfia-next-dev-pg psql -U sfia_next_dev -d sfia_next_dev -t -A -c ${JSON.stringify(oneLine)}`,
+    { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 20_000_000 },
+  ).trim();
+}
+
+async function turn(preparationId, content, extra = {}) {
+  return api(`/api/preparations/${preparationId}/messages`, {
+    method: "POST",
+    body: {
+      content,
+      clientTurnKey: extra.clientTurnKey || `ctk_${randomUUID()}`,
+      ...extra,
+    },
+    timeoutMs: 900_000,
+  });
+}
+
+const report = { steps: [], verdict: null, errors: [] };
+
+try {
+  await api("/api/dev/auto-session", { method: "POST" });
+  const runId = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
+  const projectName = `EquipLoans Cap ${runId}`;
+
+  const prep = await api("/api/preparations", { method: "POST", body: {} });
+  save("01-prep", prep);
+  const preparationId = prep.json?.preparationId;
+  if (!preparationId) throw new Error(`no preparationId: ${JSON.stringify(prep.json).slice(0, 400)}`);
+
+  let g = await api(`/api/preparations/${preparationId}`);
+  let rev = g.json.preparation.creationRevision;
+  await api(`/api/preparations/${preparationId}`, {
+    method: "PATCH",
+    body: {
+      previewName: projectName,
+      previewSummary:
+        "Petite application interne de prêt de matériel informatique pour gestionnaires. V1 : lister, prêter, suivre, retourner. Pas de portail collaborateur, pas de réservations.",
+      expectedCreationRevision: rev,
+    },
+  });
+  g = await api(`/api/preparations/${preparationId}`);
+  rev = g.json.preparation.creationRevision;
+
+  const createProj = await api(`/api/preparations/${preparationId}/create-project`, {
+    method: "POST",
+    body: {
+      expectedCreationRevision: rev,
+      projectName,
+      idempotencyKey: `cap-${randomUUID()}`,
+      previewSummary:
+        "Petite application interne de prêt de matériel. V1 gestionnaires : lister, prêter, suivre, retourner.",
+    },
+  });
+  save("04-create-project", createProj);
+  const projectId = createProj.json?.projectId;
+  if (!projectId) throw new Error(`create-project failed: ${JSON.stringify(createProj.json).slice(0, 600)}`);
+
+  let iq = null;
+  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
+    const r = await api(`/api/projects/${projectId}/initial-qualification/reconcile`, {
+      method: "POST",
+      timeoutMs: 60_000,
+    });
+    iq = r.json?.initialQualification || r.json;
+    if (iq?.status && !["PENDING", "RUNNING", "UNKNOWN"].includes(iq.status)) break;
+    await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 2000));
+  }
+  report.steps.push({
+    step: "IQ",
+    status: iq?.status || null,
+    kind: iq?.result?.kind || iq?.kind || null,
+  });
+  save("05-iq", iq);
+
+  // Natural document create — FORBIDDEN words avoided
+  const createDoc = await turn(
+    preparationId,
+    "Prépare-moi un document de conception fonctionnelle V1 d'EquipLoans à partir de nos échanges. Intègre le périmètre validé, les règles métier (dont RM-03 : date de retour prévue facultative), le parcours gestionnaire et des scénarios de recette dont R04 pour un prêt sans échéance.",
+  );
+  save("06-create-doc", {
+    status: createDoc.status,
+    documentSave: createDoc.json?.documentSave,
+    pending: createDoc.json?.pendingDocumentCandidate
+      ? { title: createDoc.json.pendingDocumentCandidate.title, id: createDoc.json.pendingDocumentCandidate.id }
+      : null,
+    intents: (createDoc.json?.semanticQualification?.intents || []).map((i) => ({
+      c: i.capabilityId,
+      m: i.mode,
+    })),
+    replyPreview: (createDoc.json?.assistantMessage?.content || "").slice(0, 400),
+  });
+  const createOk = createDoc.json?.documentSave?.status === "AVAILABLE";
+  report.steps.push({
+    step: "CREATE_DOC",
+    ok: createOk,
+    documentSave: createDoc.json?.documentSave || null,
+    modes: (createDoc.json?.semanticQualification?.intents || []).map((i) => i.mode),
+  });
+  if (!createOk) report.errors.push("CREATE_DOC_NOT_AVAILABLE");
+
+  const docId = createDoc.json?.documentSave?.documentId;
+  const baseRev = createDoc.json?.documentSave?.revisionId;
+
+  // Natural multi-section revise — inspection before conservation
+  const revise = await turn(
+    preparationId,
+    "Je souhaite rendre obligatoire la date de retour prévue pour chaque prêt. Modifie uniquement la règle RM-03 dans la section 2 et adapte le scénario R04 dans la section 4 pour vérifier qu'un prêt sans date de retour prévue est désormais refusé. Conserve strictement le reste du document à l'identique et présente-moi la nouvelle version pour inspection avant conservation.",
+  );
+  save("07-revise", {
+    status: revise.status,
+    documentSave: revise.json?.documentSave,
+    pending: revise.json?.pendingDocumentCandidate
+      ? {
+          id: revise.json.pendingDocumentCandidate.id,
+          title: revise.json.pendingDocumentCandidate.title,
+          sha: revise.json.pendingDocumentCandidate.contentSha256,
+          hasBody: Boolean(revise.json.pendingDocumentCandidate.contentMarkdown),
+        }
+      : null,
+    intents: (revise.json?.semanticQualification?.intents || []).map((i) => ({
+      c: i.capabilityId,
+      m: i.mode,
+      section: i.parameters?.sectionHint,
+    })),
+    replyPreview: (revise.json?.assistantMessage?.content || "").slice(0, 400),
+  });
+  const pending = revise.json?.pendingDocumentCandidate;
+  const revisePending =
+    revise.json?.documentSave?.reason === "PROPOSAL_PENDING_CONSERVATION" && pending?.id;
+  report.steps.push({
+    step: "REVISE_PENDING",
+    ok: Boolean(revisePending),
+    reason: revise.json?.documentSave?.reason || null,
+    pendingId: pending?.id || null,
+  });
+  if (!revisePending) report.errors.push("REVISE_NO_PENDING_CANDIDATE");
+
+  // Conserve if pending
+  if (pending?.id && docId) {
+    const conserve = await turn(preparationId, "Conserver comme nouvelle version la proposition documentaire préparée.", {
+      documentFocus: {
+        documentId: docId,
+        baseRevisionId: baseRev,
+        pendingCandidateId: pending.id,
+        pendingCandidateContentSha256:
+          pending.sha || revise.json.pendingDocumentCandidate.contentSha256,
+        conserveProposal: true,
+      },
+    });
+    save("08-conserve", {
+      status: conserve.status,
+      documentSave: conserve.json?.documentSave,
+    });
+    const conserved = conserve.json?.documentSave?.status === "AVAILABLE";
+    report.steps.push({ step: "CONSERVE", ok: conserved, documentSave: conserve.json?.documentSave });
+    if (!conserved) report.errors.push("CONSERVE_FAILED");
+  }
+
+  // Note from conversation (natural) — first pass must persist
+  const note = await turn(
+    preparationId,
+    "Prépare-moi une courte note de recommandation technique résumant la règle d'échéance obligatoire et le scénario de refus associé, à partir de nos échanges. Pas besoin de relancer une investigation.",
+  );
+  save("09-note", {
+    status: note.status,
+    documentSave: note.json?.documentSave,
+    intents: (note.json?.semanticQualification?.intents || []).map((i) => ({
+      c: i.capabilityId,
+      m: i.mode,
+    })),
+    replyPreview: (note.json?.assistantMessage?.content || "").slice(0, 400),
+  });
+  const noteOk = note.json?.documentSave?.status === "AVAILABLE";
+  report.steps.push({ step: "NOTE_FIRST_PASS", ok: noteOk, documentSave: note.json?.documentSave });
+  if (!noteOk) report.errors.push("NOTE_NOT_CREATED_FIRST_PASS");
+
+  // Activity sample
+  const activity = pg(
+    `SELECT count(*)||'|'||coalesce(string_agg(DISTINCT phase, ','), '') FROM nora_activity_events e JOIN conversations c ON c.id=e.conversation_id WHERE c.project_id='${projectId}'`,
+  );
+  report.steps.push({ step: "ACTIVITY", activity });
+  report.steps.push({
+    step: "IQ_FORECAST",
+    status: iq?.status || null,
+    cycles: (iq?.forecastSteps || []).map((s) => s.cycleType),
+  });
+
+  report.verdict =
+    report.errors.length === 0
+      ? "LIVE_NATURAL_PATH_PASS"
+      : `LIVE_NATURAL_PATH_PARTIAL:${report.errors.join(",")}`;
+} catch (e) {
+  report.verdict = "LIVE_NATURAL_PATH_FAILED";
+  report.errors.push(String(e?.stack || e));
+}
+
+save("99-report", report);
+console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
+process.exit(report.errors.length ? 1 : 0);

 /**
@@ -409,3 +410,148 @@ export function compactActivitySummary(

+
+export type ActivityGroupView = {
+  key: string;
+  title: string;
+  description: string;
+  state: ActivityStepState;
+  /** Compact count line e.g. « 8 fichiers consultés, dont 2 partiellement » */
+  resultSummary: string | null;
+  details: Array<{
+    key: string;
+    title: string;
+    coverage: string;
+    kind: string;
+  }>;
+};
+
+function groupKeyForPhase(phase: string): string {
+  if (/objective|investigation\.engaged/i.test(phase)) return "understand";
+  if (/source\.(git|d4|web|history)/i.test(phase)) return "sources";
+  if (/contract\.prepare|document|d4\.|pending|conserv/i.test(phase)) return "produce";
+  if (/generate|restitution|complete/i.test(phase)) return "restitute";
+  return "work";
+}
+
+const GROUP_META: Record<string, { title: string; description: string }> = {
+  understand: {
+    title: "Compréhension du besoin",
+    description: "Orientation du travail à partir de la demande du Pilote.",
+  },
+  sources: {
+    title: "Consultation des sources",
+    description: "Documents, Git et historiques réellement mobilisés.",
+  },
+  produce: {
+    title: "Production et validation",
+    description: "Préparation documentaire, candidat ou enregistrement.",
+  },
+  restitute: {
+    title: "Restitution",
+    description: "Consolidation de la réponse pour le Pilote.",
+  },
+  work: {
+    title: "Travail en cours",
+    description: "Opérations observées pendant le tour.",
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * Hierarchical métier groups for LIVE activity (AT-01).
+ * Adaptive: only groups with real events appear. Details stay foldable in UI.
+ * Caps synthetic list length; never drops sources from the underlying journal.
+ */
+export function buildActivityGroups(
+  events: Array<ActivityLabelInput & { sequence: number; nature: string; status: string }>,
+): ActivityGroupView[] {
+  const sources = buildActivitySources(events);
+  const byGroup = new Map<string, typeof events>();
+  for (const ev of events) {
+    const gk = groupKeyForPhase(ev.phase || "");
+    const list = byGroup.get(gk) || [];
+    list.push(ev);
+    byGroup.set(gk, list);
+  }
+  const order = ["understand", "sources", "produce", "restitute", "work"];
+  const groups: ActivityGroupView[] = [];
+  for (const key of order) {
+    const list = byGroup.get(key);
+    if (!list?.length) continue;
+    const meta = GROUP_META[key] || GROUP_META.work!;
+    let worst: ActivityStepState = "done";
+    for (const ev of list) {
+      const st = authoritativeState(ev);
+      if (st === "failed") worst = "failed";
+      else if (st === "limited" && worst !== "failed") worst = "limited";
+      else if (st === "current" && worst === "done") worst = "current";
+    }
+    let resultSummary: string | null = null;
+    let details: ActivityGroupView["details"] = [];
+    if (key === "sources") {
+      const consulted = sources.filter((s) =>
+        ["CONSULTED", "VERIFIED", "COMPLETE"].includes(s.coverage),
+      ).length;
+      const partial = sources.filter((s) => s.coverage === "PARTIAL").length;
+      const denied = sources.filter((s) => s.coverage === "DENIED").length;
+      const discovered = sources.filter((s) => s.coverage === "DISCOVERED").length;
+      const bits: string[] = [];
+      if (sources.length) bits.push(`${sources.length} source${sources.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
+      if (consulted) bits.push(`${consulted} consultée${consulted > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
+      if (partial) bits.push(`${partial} partielle${partial > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
+      if (denied) bits.push(`${denied} inaccessible${denied > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
+      if (discovered && !consulted) bits.push(`${discovered} identifiée${discovered > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
+      resultSummary = bits.join(", ") || null;
+      details = sources.map((s) => ({
+        key: s.key,
+        title: s.title,
+        coverage: s.coverage,
+        kind: s.kind,
+      }));
+    } else {
+      const steps = buildActivitySteps(list);
+      resultSummary =
+        steps.length > 1 ? `${steps.length} opérations observées` : steps[0]?.label || null;
+      details = steps.slice(0, 40).map((s) => ({
+        key: s.key,
+        title: s.label,
+        coverage: s.state.toUpperCase(),
+        kind: "STEP",
+      }));
+    }
+    groups.push({
+      key,
+      title: meta.title,
+      description: meta.description,
+      state: worst,
+      resultSummary,
+      details,
+    });
+  }
+  return groups;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Mission-level headline: prefer objective events; never last filename alone.
+ */
+export function projectMissionHeadline(
+  events: Array<ActivityLabelInput & { sequence: number; nature: string }>,
+): string {
+  const objective = [...events]
+    .reverse()
+    .find(
+      (e) =>
+        /objective|investigation\.engaged/i.test(e.phase || "") ||
+        detailString(e.detail, "objective"),
+    );
+  if (objective) {
+    const o = detailString(objective.detail, "objective") || objective.summary;
+    if (o && !looksTechnical(o) && !/^Prise en charge/i.test(o)) return o.slice(0, 160);
+  }
+  const last = events[events.length - 1];
+  if (last) {
+    const headline = projectActivityLabel(last).slice(0, 160);
+    if (headline && !/Consultation Git —/i.test(headline)) return headline;
+  }
+  return "Activité Nora";
+}

+}
+
+/** Extract forecast steps from Nora qualification pilotage PREPARE intents. */
+export function forecastStepsFromQualificationIntents(
+  intents: Array<{
+    capabilityId: string;
+    mode: string;
+    parameters?: { pilotageOperation?: string; cycleType?: string; notes?: string };
+    summary?: string;
+  }>,
+): ForecastStep[] {
+  const steps: ForecastStep[] = [];
+  for (const intent of intents) {
+    if (intent.capabilityId !== "d5.pilotage_command") continue;
+    if (intent.mode !== "PREPARE" && intent.mode !== "REQUEST_EFFECT") continue;
+    const op = intent.parameters?.pilotageOperation;
+    if (op && op !== "PROPOSE_TRAJECTORY") continue;
+    const cycleType = intent.parameters?.cycleType;
+    if (!cycleType || !isCycleType(cycleType)) continue;
+    steps.push({
+      order: steps.length + 1,
+      cycleType,
+      rationale: intent.summary?.trim() || intent.parameters?.notes?.trim() || "",
+      certainty: steps.length === 0 ? "QUALIFIED" : "ENVISIONED",
+    });
+  }
+  return steps;
+}
+
+export { CYCLE_TYPES };

+/**
+ * ML5 — Nora proposes structured forecast steps; D5 validates catalog membership.
+ * Replaces lexical inferPreferredFirstCycle. No regex / dictionary cycle choice.
+ */
+async function buildCognitiveForecast(input: {
+  projection: ReturnType<typeof parseProjectionJson> | null;
+  previewSummary: string;
+  projectName: string;
+}): Promise<{
+  built: ForecastBuildResult;
+  structureSource: "NORA_COGNITIVE" | "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK";
+}> {
+  const sufficiency = forecastInputSufficiency({
+    projection: input.projection,
+    previewSummary: input.previewSummary,
+  });
+  if (!sufficiency.ok) {
+    return { built: sufficiency.result, structureSource: "STRUCTURED_FALLBACK" };
+  }
+  const catalogLines = CYCLE_TYPES.map(
+    (t) => `- ${t} (${CYCLE_LABELS[t]})`,
+  ).join("\n");
+  try {
+    const { generateNoraReply } = await import("@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter");
+    const { buildCognitivePolicy } = await import("@/domains/conversation/cognitive-policy");
+    const policy = buildCognitivePolicy(
+      `Qualification trajectoire ${input.projectName}`,
+      undefined,
+      { profileHint: "analyse", effortHint: "medium" },
+    );
+    const slimPolicy = {
+      ...policy,
+      toolAllowlist: [] as typeof policy.toolAllowlist,
+      budgets: {
+        ...policy.budgets,
+        maxProviderCalls: Math.min(policy.budgets.maxProviderCalls, 2),
+        maxD4ToolCalls: 0,
+        maxGitToolCalls: 0,
+        maxD4CharsReturned: 0,
+      },
+    };
+    const reply = await generateNoraReply({
+      userText: [
+        `Le projet « ${input.projectName} » vient d'être créé.`,
+        "Propose une première trajectoire de cycles SFIA proportionnée.",
+        "Choisis 1 à 3 types de cycles dans le catalogue canonique ci-dessous.",
+        "Émets des intents d5.pilotage_command mode=PREPARE operation=PROPOSE_TRAJECTORY avec parameters.cycleType pour chaque étape (ordre = ordre des intents).",
+        "N'ouvre aucun cycle. Ne demande pas au Pilote de choisir un type de cycle si les acquis SAS suffisent.",
+        "Clarifie seulement si l'intention ou le résultat utile manquent vraiment.",
+      ].join("\n"),
+      contextSnippets: [
+        `Intention: ${input.projection?.intention?.value || "(non précisée)"}`,
+        `Résultat attendu: ${input.projection?.desiredOutcome?.value || "(non précisé)"}`,
+        `Périmètre: ${input.projection?.initialScope?.value || "(non précisé)"}`,
+        (input.projection?.openQuestions ?? [])
+          .map((q) => q.value?.trim())
+          .filter(Boolean)
+          .length
+          ? `Points ouverts: ${(input.projection?.openQuestions ?? [])
+              .map((q) => q.value?.trim())
+              .filter(Boolean)
+              .slice(0, 8)
+              .join(" · ")}`
+          : "Points ouverts: (aucun structuré)",
+        input.previewSummary
+          ? `Synthèse SAS: ${input.previewSummary.slice(0, 1200)}`
+          : "",
+        `Catalogue cycles SFIA (uniquement ces types):\n${catalogLines}`,
+      ].filter(Boolean),
+      policyOverride: slimPolicy,
+    });
+    const fromIntents = forecastStepsFromQualificationIntents(

+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import {
+  buildActivityGroups,
+  projectMissionHeadline,
+} from "@/domains/conversation/activity-labels";
+
+describe("ML5 LIVE activity hierarchy", () => {
+  it("groups sources under consultation with counts — not flat filename as mission title", () => {
+    const events = [
+      {
+        sequence: 1,
+        phase: "nora.objective",
+        nature: "ANNOUNCED",
+        status: "RUNNING",
+        summary: "Analyse des mécanismes de prévention du double prêt",
+        detail: { objective: "Analyse des mécanismes de prévention du double prêt", kind: "OBJECTIVE" },
+      },
+      {
+        sequence: 2,
+        phase: "nora.source.git",
+        nature: "OBSERVED",
+        status: "COMPLETED",
+        summary: "Consultation Git — planning.api.spec.ts",
+        sourceRef: "git-file:1:a",
+        detail: { kind: "GIT", coverage: "CONSULTED", title: "planning.api.spec.ts" },
+      },
+      {
+        sequence: 3,
+        phase: "nora.source.git",
+        nature: "OBSERVED",
+        status: "LIMITED",
+        summary: "Consultation Git partielle — migration.sql",
+        sourceRef: "git-file:1:b",
+        detail: { kind: "GIT", coverage: "PARTIAL", title: "migration.sql" },
+      },
+      {
+        sequence: 4,
+        phase: "nora.generate",
+        nature: "COMPLETED",
+        status: "COMPLETED",
+        summary: "Réponse Nora disponible",
+        detail: {},
+      },
+    ];
+    const groups = buildActivityGroups(events);
+    expect(groups.some((g) => g.key === "sources")).toBe(true);
+    const sources = groups.find((g) => g.key === "sources")!;
+    expect(sources.resultSummary).toMatch(/2 source/);
+    expect(sources.details.length).toBe(2);
+    expect(projectMissionHeadline(events)).toBe(
+      "Analyse des mécanismes de prévention du double prêt",
+    );
+  });
+
+  it("supports 45 deterministic operations without flattening all into the mission title", () => {
+    const events = Array.from({ length: 45 }, (_, i) => ({
+      sequence: i + 1,
+      phase: "nora.source.git",
+      nature: "OBSERVED" as const,
+      status: "COMPLETED",
+      summary: `Consultation Git — file-${i}.ts`,
+      sourceRef: `git-file:r:file-${i}.ts`,
+      detail: { kind: "GIT", coverage: "CONSULTED", title: `file-${i}.ts` },
+    }));
+    events.unshift({
+      sequence: 0,
+      phase: "nora.objective",
+      nature: "ANNOUNCED",
+      status: "RUNNING",
+      summary: "Investigation ciblée",
+      sourceRef: null as unknown as string,
+      detail: { objective: "Investigation ciblée", kind: "OBJECTIVE" },
+    });
+    const groups = buildActivityGroups(events);
+    const sources = groups.find((g) => g.key === "sources")!;
+    // Projection caps detail rows; counters still reflect known volume.
+    expect(sources.resultSummary).toMatch(/45 source/);
+    expect(sources.details.length).toBe(45);
+    expect(projectMissionHeadline(events)).toBe("Investigation ciblée");
+  });
+});
+

+    goal: "test",
+    projectIntention: "",
+    desiredOutcome: "",
+    initialScope: "",

+    intents,
+    clarifications: [],
+    replyDraft: "ok",

+  it("PREPARE revise projects documentAct with inspectionRequired — effectIntents stay empty", () => {
+    const qual = q([
+      {
+        id: "revision-rm03-r04",

+        mode: "PREPARE",

+        parameters: {

+          sectionHint: "Section 2 (RM-03) et section 4 (R04)",

+        dependsOn: [],
+        sourceEvidence: [],
+      },
+    ]);
+    expect(effectIntents(qual)).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(documentaryMaterializeIntents(qual)).toHaveLength(1);
+    const proj = projectStudioEffects(qual);
+    expect(proj.documentAct).toEqual({
+      kind: "REVISE",
+      mode: "PREPARE",
+      inspectionRequired: true,
+      intentId: "revision-rm03-r04",
+      documentHint: "AssetTrack — Conception fonctionnelle V1",
+      sectionHint: "Section 2 (RM-03) et section 4 (R04)",
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("PREPARE create projects CREATE without widening D7 PREPARE to publication", () => {
+    const qual = q([
+      {
+        id: "note-1",
+        capabilityId: "d4.create_document",

+        summary: "Préparer une note technique",
+        parameters: {},
+        constraints: [],
+        dependsOn: [],

+      {
